title.zh: 卷309 列傳九十六 崔纪 喀尔吉善 定长 鄂雲布 雅尔图 晏斯盛 瑚宝 卫哲治 苏昌 鹤年 吴达善 崔应阶 王检 吴士功
title.en: Volume 309 Biographies 96: Cui Ji, Ka Er Ji Shan, Ding Zhang, E Yunbu, Ya Er Tu, Yan Sisheng, Hu Bao, Wei Zhezhi, Su Chang, He Nian, Wu Dashan, Cui Yingjie, Wang Jian, Wu Shigong
title.raw: 卷309 列傳九十六 崔纪 喀尔吉善 定长 鄂雲布 雅尔图 晏斯盛 瑚宝 卫哲治 苏昌 鹤年 吴达善 崔应阶 王检 吴士功

sentences.zh: =崔紀=崔紀，初名珺，字南有，山西永濟人。

translations.literal: Cui Ji: Cui Ji, original name Jun, courtesy name Nanyou, a native of Yongji in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Ji, whose original name was Jun and whose courtesy name was Nanyou, was a native of Yongji in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 年幼喪母，哀毀如成人。

translations.literal: In youth he lost his mother and mourned with grief and self-mortification like an adult.
translations.idiomatic: He lost his mother while still young and mourned her with a grief and self-restraint worthy of a grown man.

sentences.zh: 事父及後母孝。

translations.literal: He served his father and stepmother with filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: He was filial toward both his father and his stepmother.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十七年，成進士，改庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year of Kangxi he passed the jinshi examination, was transferred to Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year of the Kangxi reign (1718) he passed the jinshi examination, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed compiler.

sentences.zh: 遷國子監司業，以母憂歸。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be vice director of the Directorate of Education and returned home on account of mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice director of the Directorate of Education, then left office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 服闋，補故官。

translations.literal: When the mourning period ended, he was restored to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning ended, he resumed his former office.

sentences.zh: 三遷祭酒。

translations.literal: After three promotions he became chancellor of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: After three further promotions he became chancellor of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，提督順天學政。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he was promoted to be educational commissioner of Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Qianlong reign (1736) he was appointed educational commissioner of Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，採安徽學政李鳳翥、河南學政習俊、浙江學政王蘭生條議：每歲令諸生五人互結，無抗糧攬訟；

translations.literal: During the Yongzheng period regulations were adopted from the proposals of Li Fengzhu, educational commissioner of Anhui, Xi Jun of Henan, and Wang Lansheng of Zhejiang: each year students were to form mutual-guarantee groups of five, with no resistance to tax payment or seizure of lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng period the court had adopted proposals from the educational commissioners Li Fengzhu of Anhui, Xi Jun of Henan, and Wang Lansheng of Zhejiang: each year students were to form mutual-guarantee groups of five, barred from resisting tax payments or monopolizing lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 諸生有事告州縣，當先以呈詞赴學掛號；

translations.literal: When students had business to bring before prefectures and counties, they had first to file their petitions at the school for registration.
translations.idiomatic: If students wished to lodge complaints with prefectural or county authorities, they had first to register their petitions at the school.

sentences.zh: 為人作證及冒認命盜案，先革後審；

translations.literal: In cases of giving testimony for others or falsely claiming robbery with murder, they were first stripped of student status and then tried.
translations.idiomatic: Students who testified on others' behalf or falsely claimed robbery with murder were stripped of their status before trial.

sentences.zh: 諸生毆殺人及代寫詞狀，加常罪一等；

translations.literal: Students who beat others to death or drafted petitions and plaints for others received one degree heavier than the ordinary penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Students convicted of beating someone to death or of drafting legal documents for others were punished one degree more severely than ordinary offenders.

sentences.zh: 已斥諸生不許出境；

translations.literal: Students already expelled were not permitted to leave the district.
translations.idiomatic: Expelled students were forbidden to leave the jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 諸生欠糧，必全完乃收考。

translations.literal: Students in arrears on grain tax had to pay in full before being admitted to examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Students who owed grain tax could not sit for examinations until the debt was paid in full.

sentences.zh: 紀疏請罷之。

translations.literal: Cui memorialized requesting that these measures be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Cui submitted a memorial asking that these rules be repealed.

sentences.zh: 又定諸生月課三次不到，詳革，紀請改一年；

translations.literal: It was also fixed that students who missed three monthly examinations should be reported for expulsion; Cui asked that this be changed to one year.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations also provided that students who missed three monthly examinations in a row were to be reported for expulsion; Cui asked that the period be extended to one year.

sentences.zh: 諸生完糧，上戶限十月，中、下戶限八月，紀請改歲底。

translations.literal: For students' completion of grain tax, upper households had a deadline of the tenth month and middle and lower households the eighth month; Cui asked that the deadline be moved to year's end.
translations.idiomatic: Upper households were required to complete their grain tax by the tenth month and middle and lower households by the eighth; Cui asked that all be allowed until the end of the year.

sentences.zh: 下部議行。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries deliberated and approved his requests.

sentences.zh: 遷詹事，再遷倉場侍郎，署甘肅巡撫。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be grand tutor, then again to be vice president of the Granary Administration, and served as acting governor of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to grand tutor, then to vice president of the Granary Administration, and was appointed acting governor of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 二年，移署陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the second year he was transferred to serve as acting governor of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qianlong he was transferred to serve as acting governor of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「陝屬平原八百餘裡，農率待澤於天，旱則束手。

translations.literal: He memorialized, saying: "Within Shaanxi the plains extend more than eight hundred li; farmers generally depend on Heaven for moisture, and in drought they are helpless.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Shaanxi's plains stretch more than eight hundred li, and farmers there generally depend on rainfall; in drought they are helpless.

sentences.zh: 惟鑿井灌田​​，實可補雨澤之缺。

translations.literal: Only by digging wells to irrigate fields can the lack of rain truly be made up.
translations.idiomatic: Digging wells to irrigate fields can truly make up for the lack of rain.

sentences.zh: 臣居蒲州，習見其利。

translations.literal: Your servant lived in Puzhou and is accustomed to seeing its benefits.
translations.idiomatic: Having lived in Puzhou, I am well acquainted with the benefits.

sentences.zh: 陝屬延安、榆林、邠、鄜、綏德各府州，地高土厚，不能鑿井。

translations.literal: In Shaanxi the prefectures and departments of Yan'an, Yulin, Bin, Fu, and Suide have high ground and thick soil and cannot have wells dug.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yan'an, Yulin, Bin, Fu, and Suide prefectures and departments of Shaanxi the land is high and the soil thick, and wells cannot be sunk there.

sentences.zh: 此外西安、同州、鳳翔、漢中四府並渭南九州縣最低，渭北二十餘州縣地較高，掘地一二丈至六七丈，皆可得水。

translations.literal: Apart from these, the four prefectures Xi'an, Tongzhou, Fengxiang, and Hanzhong together with the nine counties of Weinan are lowest; north of the Wei more than twenty prefectures and counties are somewhat higher, and digging from one or two zhang to six or seven zhang all yields water.
translations.idiomatic: Elsewhere the four prefectures of Xi'an, Tongzhou, Fengxiang, and Hanzhong and the nine counties of Weinan lie lowest; north of the Wei more than twenty prefectures and counties sit somewhat higher, yet water can be reached by digging anywhere from one or two to six or seven zhang.

sentences.zh: 勸諭鑿井，貧民實難勉強。

translations.literal: To exhort and instruct them to dig wells is truly hard for poor people to manage.
translations.idiomatic: Urging the poor to dig wells is something they can scarcely manage on their own.

sentences.zh: 懇準將地丁羨銀借給充費，分三年繳完。

translations.literal: I beg permission to lend them the surplus from land and poll taxes to cover the expense, to be repaid over three years.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that surplus land-and-poll tax silver be lent to cover the cost, to be repaid over three years.

sentences.zh: 民力況瘁，與河泉自然水利不同。

translations.literal: The people's strength is already exhausted, unlike the natural waterworks of rivers and springs.
translations.idiomatic: The people's strength is already exhausted; this is not the same as harnessing natural river and spring water.

sentences.zh: 請免以水田昇科。」

translations.literal: I ask that fields converted to irrigated land be exempted from upgraded tax assessment."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that fields brought under irrigation be exempted from the higher tax rate applied to irrigated land."

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「此極應行之美舉，當徐徐化導，實力奉行，自不能視水田昇科也。」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed, saying: "This is an excellent measure that ought very much to be carried out; it should be introduced gradually through persuasion and firmly put into practice, and naturally cannot be treated like upgrading tax on irrigated fields."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "This is an excellent measure that ought to be carried out; introduce it gradually through persuasion and enforce it in earnest—you certainly cannot treat it like ordinary upgrades to irrigated-land taxation."

sentences.zh: 擢吏部侍郎，仍留巡撫，尋實授。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice minister of Personnel, remained as governor, and soon received formal appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice minister of Personnel while remaining governor of Shaanxi, and soon received the substantive appointment.

sentences.zh: 紀疏言：「陝西水利，莫如龍洞渠，上承涇水，中受諸泉。

translations.literal: Cui memorialized, saying: "Of Shaanxi waterworks none equals the Longdong Canal, which above receives the Jing River and midway gathers various springs.
translations.idiomatic: Cui memorialized: "Of Shaanxi's waterworks none equals the Longdong Canal, which draws from the Jing River above and collects numerous springs along its course.

sentences.zh: 自雍正間總督岳鍾琪發帑修濬，涇陽、醴泉、三原、高陵諸縣資以灌溉。

translations.literal: Since the Yongzheng period Governor-General Yue Zhongqi disbursed funds to repair and dredge it, and the counties Jingyang, Liquan, Sanyuan, and Gaoling rely on it for irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Yongzheng period Governor-General Yue Zhongqi had disbursed treasury funds to repair and dredge it, and the counties of Jingyang, Liquan, Sanyuan, and Gaoling depended on it for irrigation.

sentences.zh: 惟未定歲修法，涇漲入渠，泥沙淀閼，泉泛出渠，石罅滲漏。

translations.literal: Only no annual maintenance rule had been fixed; when the Jing swelled and entered the canal, mud and sand silted and blocked it, springs overflowed out of the canal, and water seeped through cracks in the stone.
translations.idiomatic: Yet no annual maintenance schedule had been fixed: when the Jing flooded into the canal, silt choked it; springs overflowed the banks; and water leaked through cracks in the stonework.

sentences.zh: 擬於龍洞高築石堤，以納眾泉，不使入涇。

translations.literal: It is proposed to build a high stone embankment at Longdong to receive the various springs and keep them from entering the Jing.
translations.idiomatic: I propose building a high stone embankment at Longdong to collect the springs and keep them from flowing into the Jing.

sentences.zh: 水磨橋、大王橋諸泉亦筑壩其旁，收入渠內。

translations.literal: The springs at Shuimo Bridge and Dawang Bridge should also have dams built beside them to channel the water into the canal.
translations.idiomatic: Dams should also be built beside the springs at Shuimo Bridge and Dawang Bridge to channel their water into the canal.

sentences.zh: 並額定水工，司啟閉。」

translations.literal: Water workers should also be appointed by quota to manage opening and closing."
translations.idiomatic: Permanent water workers should be appointed to manage the sluices."

sentences.zh: 均從之。

translations.literal: All was approved.
translations.idiomatic: All his proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 陝西民憚興作，言紀煩擾。

translations.literal: The people of Shaanxi feared public works and said Cui was a nuisance.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Shaanxi feared public works and complained that Cui was harassing them.

sentences.zh: 上令詳勘地勢，俯順輿情。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered a detailed survey of the terrain and deference to public sentiment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered a thorough survey of the terrain and told him to defer to local opinion.

sentences.zh: 三年，命與湖北巡撫張楷互調，時報新開井七萬餘，上令楷察勘。

translations.literal: In the third year he was ordered to exchange posts with Zhang Kai, governor of Hubei; at the time it was reported that more than seventy thousand new wells had been opened, and the emperor ordered Zhang Kai to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was ordered to exchange posts with Zhang Kai, governor of Hubei; reports claimed more than seventy thousand new wells had been dug, and the emperor ordered Zhang Kai to inspect them.

sentences.zh: 楷言民間食其利者三萬二千餘，遇旱，井效乃見。

translations.literal: Zhang Kai said that more than thirty-two thousand among the people were benefiting from them; only in drought did the wells' effect become visible.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Kai reported that more than thirty-two thousand wells were actually benefiting the people, and that their value became clear only in drought.

sentences.zh: 民益私鑿井，歲歲增廣矣。

translations.literal: The people increasingly dug wells on their own, and year by year the number grew.
translations.idiomatic: The people went on digging wells privately, and the number grew year after year.

sentences.zh: 紀至湖北，自陳不職，部議降調。

translations.literal: When Cui reached Hubei he confessed himself unfit for office, and the ministry recommended demotion and transfer.
translations.idiomatic: When Cui arrived in Hubei he confessed himself unfit for office, and the ministry recommended demotion.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「紀在陝西鑿井灌田，料理未善，致反貽民累。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed, saying: "Cui in Shaanxi dug wells to irrigate fields; the arrangements were not well managed and instead imposed burdens on the people.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "In Shaanxi Cui promoted well-digging for irrigation; the work was poorly managed and ended up burdening the people.

sentences.zh: 惟其本意為民，命從寬留任。」

translations.literal: Yet since his original intent was for the people, he was ordered to be leniently allowed to remain in office."
translations.idiomatic: Yet because his original intent was to serve the people, he was allowed to remain in office with leniency."

sentences.zh: 五年。

translations.literal: In the fifth year.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year.

sentences.zh: 總督德沛劾紀以公使錢畀護糧道崔乃鏞，上又聞紀以淮鹽到遲，令民間暫食私鹽，諭紀自列，紀疏辨，下部議，降調。

translations.literal: Governor-General De Pei impeached Cui for giving mission funds to Grain Transport Intendant Cui Naiyong; the emperor also heard that because Huai salt arrived late Cui had allowed the people temporarily to consume private salt; Cui was instructed to set forth the facts himself, memorialized in defense, the matter was referred to the ministries, and demotion was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General De Pei impeached Cui for giving official mission funds to Grain Transport Intendant Cui Naiyong; the emperor also heard that because Huai salt arrived late Cui had allowed the people to consume private salt temporarily. Cui was told to explain himself, submitted a defense, and after ministry deliberation was demoted.

sentences.zh: 六年，再授祭酒。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was again appointed chancellor of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was again appointed chancellor of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 九年，督江蘇學政。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he supervised as educational commissioner of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was appointed educational commissioner of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 以父憂歸。

translations.literal: He returned home on account of mourning for his father.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home to mourn his father.

sentences.zh: 十四年，起授山東布政使。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was recalled and appointed provincial treasurer of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was recalled and appointed provincial treasurer of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 以東省貧民借官穀累百萬石，請視部定價石六錢，收折色，紓民力。

translations.literal: Because the poor of the eastern province had borrowed official grain totaling a million shi, he asked that collection follow the ministry's fixed price of six cash per shi in commuted silver to ease the people's burden.
translations.idiomatic: Because poor households in Shandong had borrowed more than a million shi of official grain, he asked that repayment be collected at the ministry rate of six cash per shi in commuted silver to ease their burden.

sentences.zh: 十五年，命以副都御史銜再督江蘇學政，力疾按試。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was ordered, with the rank of vice censor-in-chief, again to supervise Jiangsu as educational commissioner and, though ill, pressed on with the examinations.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was ordered, with the rank of vice censor-in-chief, to resume duty as educational commissioner of Jiangsu and, though ill, pressed on with the examinations.

sentences.zh: 旋卒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 紀潛心理學，上亦聞之，再任祭酒，召見，命作太極圖說。

translations.literal: Cui had devoted himself to Neo-Confucian learning; the emperor also heard of this, and when he was again appointed chancellor he was summoned and ordered to compose an exposition of the Diagram of the Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: Cui had devoted himself to Neo-Confucian philosophy; the emperor had heard of it, and when Cui was again appointed chancellor he was summoned and ordered to write an exposition of the Diagram of the Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 歷官所至，以教養為先。

translations.literal: Wherever he served in office, he put instruction and nurturing first.
translations.idiomatic: In every post he held, he put education and nurturing the people first.

sentences.zh: 遇事有不可，輒艴然曰：「士君子當引君當道，奈何若是？」

translations.literal: When he encountered something unacceptable he would flush angrily and say: "A gentleman should lead his ruler along the right path—how can it be like this?"
translations.idiomatic: When he encountered something he could not accept, he would flush with anger and say: "A gentleman should guide his ruler along the right path—how can matters stand like this?"

sentences.zh: =喀爾吉善=喀爾吉善，字澹園，伊爾根覺羅氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Ka Erjishan: Ka Erjishan, courtesy name Tanyuan, of the Irgen Gioro clan, a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Ka Erjishan, courtesy name Tanyuan, of the Irgen Gioro clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 先世居瓦爾喀，有赫臣者，當太祖創業時來歸，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: His ancestors lived in Warka; there was one He Chen who came over when the Taizu was founding the enterprise and was appointed niru commander.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestors had lived in Warka. A forebear named He Chen submitted when the Taizu was founding the dynasty and was appointed niru commander.

sentences.zh: 使葉赫，葉赫部長金台石使人戕之。

translations.literal: Sent on a mission to Yehe, he was killed by men sent by Yehe chieftain Gintaisi.
translations.idiomatic: On a mission to Yehe he was murdered by agents of the Yehe chieftain Gintaisi.

sentences.zh: 太祖滅葉赫，令其子克宜福手刃其仇以祭。

translations.literal: When the Taizu destroyed Yehe, he had his son Keyifu personally slay the murderer as a sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taizu destroyed Yehe, he had Keyifu, He Chen's son, slay the murderer with his own hand as an offering to his father's spirit.

sentences.zh: 克宜福從軍有功，世職至三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: Keyifu followed the army with merit and the hereditary office reached third-rank adahahafan.
translations.idiomatic: Keyifu served with distinction and the family hereditary rank rose to third-class adahahafan.

sentences.zh: 克宜福子喀齊蘭，官至正黃旗副都統；

translations.literal: Keyifu's son Ka Qilan rose to vice commander of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Keyifu's son Ka Qilan rose to vice commander of the Plain Yellow Banner;

sentences.zh: 孫凱里布​​，官至吏部尚書：皆襲世職。

translations.literal: His grandson Kai Libu rose to minister of Personnel: all inherited the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: his grandson Kai Libu rose to minister of Personnel—all inherited the family rank.

sentences.zh: 喀爾吉善降襲拜他喇布勒哈番，授上駟院員外郎。

translations.literal: Ka Erjishan inherited at a reduced rank the betalabulehafan and was appointed assistant director of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: Ka Erjishan inherited the family rank at a reduced grade as betalabulehafan and was appointed assistant director of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 歷工部郎中，兼襲世管佐領。

translations.literal: He served as director in the Ministry of Works and concurrently inherited the hereditary company command.
translations.idiomatic: He served as a director in the Ministry of Works while also inheriting the hereditary company command.

sentences.zh: 雍正六年，命偕通政使留保如廣東按署巡撫阿克敦等被劾狀。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yongzheng he was ordered together with Censor-in-chief Liu Bao to go to Guangdong to investigate the impeachment of Acting Governor Akedun and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Yongzheng he was ordered, together with Censor-in-chief Liu Bao, to go to Guangdong and investigate charges against Acting Governor Akedun and others.

sentences.zh: 八年，擢兵部額外侍郎。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was promoted to extra vice minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was promoted to extra vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 九年，授侍郎。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he received substantive appointment as vice minister.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以驗馬不實奪官，令往盛京收糧。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, because horse inspection was found false, he was stripped of office and ordered to go to Mukden to collect grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was dismissed for falsifying horse inspections and ordered to Mukden to collect grain.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，起廢籍，命管​​圓明園八旗兵丁。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he was raised from the dismissed rolls and ordered to manage the Eight Banner troops at the Yuanming Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianlong he was restored from the dismissed rolls and ordered to manage the Eight Banner garrison at the Yuanming Yuan.

sentences.zh: 復往盛京收糧，奏禁八旗台站官兵與朝鮮貿易。

translations.literal: Again sent to Mukden to collect grain, he memorialized forbidding Eight Banner courier-station officers and soldiers to trade with Korea.
translations.idiomatic: Sent again to Mukden to collect grain, he memorialized forbidding Eight Banner courier-station troops to trade with Korea.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「官兵不暇貿易，亦不諳貿易。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed, saying: "Officers and soldiers have no leisure for trade and are not skilled in trade.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Soldiers have no time for trade and are not skilled in it.

sentences.zh: 當令商民與互巿，務均平交易，毋抑價，毋強索。」

translations.literal: Merchants should be made to trade with them at the frontier markets, with even and fair exchange, without suppressing prices or making forced demands."
translations.idiomatic: Let merchants trade with them at the frontier markets on fair and equal terms, without price-fixing or extortion."

sentences.zh: 三年，擢內閣學士。

translations.literal: In the third year he was promoted to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was promoted to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 遷戶部侍郎，協理步軍統領刑名事務。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice minister of Revenue and assisted in managing criminal matters for the Metropolitan Infantry Command.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice minister of Revenue and assisted the Metropolitan Infantry Command in criminal matters.

sentences.zh: 調吏部，四年，命兼管三庫。

translations.literal: Transferred to Personnel, in the fourth year he was ordered concurrently to manage the three treasuries.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to the Ministry of Personnel, in the fourth year he was ordered concurrently to manage the three treasuries.

sentences.zh: 五年，授山西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed governor of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed governor of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 上聞山西布政使薩哈諒、學政哈爾欽皆貪婪，詢喀爾吉善。

translations.literal: The emperor heard that Shanxi provincial treasurer Sahaliang and educational commissioner Haerqin were both greedy and inquired of Ka Erjishan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor heard that Provincial Treasurer Sahaliang and Educational Commissioner Haerqin of Shanxi were both corrupt and questioned Ka Erjishan.

sentences.zh: 喀爾吉善疏劾，命侍郎楊嗣璟會鞫，論如律。

translations.literal: Ka Erjishan memorialized in impeachment; Vice Minister Yang Sijing was ordered to join in the trial, and sentence followed the law.
translations.idiomatic: Ka Erjishan memorialized to impeach them; Vice Minister Yang Sijing was ordered to join the investigation, and both were sentenced according to law.

sentences.zh: 上以喀爾吉善不即劾，下部議，奪官，命寬之。

translations.literal: Because Ka Erjishan had not impeached them immediately, the matter was referred to the ministries; he was stripped of office but the emperor ordered leniency.
translations.idiomatic: Because Ka Erjishan had not impeached them at once, the ministries recommended dismissal, but the emperor ordered leniency.

sentences.zh: 又劾河東鹽政白起圖貪婪，白起圖疏辨，命副都統塞楞額往鞫，論如律。

translations.literal: He also impeached Hedong Salt Controller Bai Qitu for greed; Bai Qitu memorialized in defense; Vice Banner Commander Sailenge was ordered to go try the case, and sentence followed the law.
translations.idiomatic: He also impeached Hedong Salt Controller Bai Qitu for corruption; Bai Qitu defended himself in a memorial; Vice Banner Commander Sailenge was sent to try the case, and sentence followed the law.

sentences.zh: 七年，調安徽。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was transferred to Anhui.

sentences.zh: 八年，復調山東。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was again transferred to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was transferred back to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「山東歲饑，民多流亡，而鄰省貧民亦有轉入山東覓食者，請飭官吏勸各回故土以待治賑。」

translations.literal: He memorialized, saying: "Shandong suffers famine year after year and many people flee; poor people from neighboring provinces also turn into Shandong seeking food; I ask that officials be ordered to urge each to return to his native place to await relief and famine administration."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Shandong suffers recurring famine and many people flee; poor people from neighboring provinces also drift into Shandong seeking food. I ask that officials urge everyone to return to his native place and await proper relief."

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「所見甚得體。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed, saying: "What you have seen is very appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "Your view is very sound.

sentences.zh: 各省督撫當於平居無事時委曲開導，使知敦本務實，力田逢年；

translations.literal: Governors-general and governors of every province should in peaceful times when nothing is amiss gently instruct the people so they know to honor the fundamental and pursue what is solid, labor in the fields and meet good harvests.
translations.idiomatic: Every governor-general and governor should, in peaceful times, patiently instruct the people to honor the fundamentals, work the land diligently, and secure good harvests;

sentences.zh: 若輕棄其鄉，本業既荒，無所依倚。

translations.literal: If they lightly abandon their native districts, their fundamental occupation is already ruined and they have nothing to rely on.
translations.idiomatic: if they lightly abandon their home districts, their livelihood is ruined and they have nowhere to turn.

sentences.zh: 即國家收養資送，亦不得已之舉，非可恃為長策也。」

translations.literal: Even if the state receives, nurtures, and sends them on, that is also a measure of last resort and cannot be relied on as a long-term policy."
translations.idiomatic: even state relief and transport are measures of last resort, not a policy to rely on indefinitely."

sentences.zh: 又以濟南、武定、東昌三府遇旱，濟南、東昌府倉存穀緩急可相通；

translations.literal: He also reported that Jinan, Wuding, and Dongchang prefectures had encountered drought; the granaries of Jinan and Dongchang could supply each other in emergency.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported drought in the prefectures of Jinan, Wuding, and Dongchang; the granaries of Jinan and Dongchang could supply each other in an emergency;

sentences.zh: 武定無倉，請撥登、萊二府倉穀以濟民食。

translations.literal: Wuding had no granary; he asked to allocate grain from the granaries of Deng and Lai prefectures to relieve the people's food.
translations.idiomatic: Wuding had no granary, and he asked to draw grain from the granaries of Deng and Lai to feed the people.

sentences.zh: 九年，疏言：「方春糧價踴貴，貧民艱食，請酌量減糶。」

translations.literal: In the ninth year he memorialized, saying: "At the beginning of spring grain prices soar and the poor have difficulty eating; I ask that sale from granaries be appropriately reduced in price."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he memorialized: "At the start of spring grain prices are soaring and the poor are going hungry; I ask that granary sales be reduced in price as appropriate."

sentences.zh: 又言：「山東兵米，本折兼支，春季價昂支折色，秋季價減支本色，請春秋二季本折更換。」

translations.literal: He also said: "Shandong military rice was originally paid in both grain and commutation; when spring prices were high they were paid in commuted silver, when autumn prices fell they were paid in grain; he asked that spring and autumn exchange grain and commutation."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Shandong military rations were originally paid partly in grain and partly in commuted silver; when spring prices were high troops were paid in silver, when autumn prices fell in grain. I ask that grain and commutation be reversed between spring and autumn."

sentences.zh: 又請修德州、海豐、惠民、樂陵城工以代賑。

translations.literal: He also asked to repair the city works of Dezhou, Haifeng, Huimin, and Leling in place of relief distribution.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to repair the city walls of Dezhou, Haifeng, Huimin, and Leling as work relief.

sentences.zh: 復以濟南、武定諸屬縣麥復不登，令於曹、沂諸府豐收之區採買接濟。

translations.literal: Again, because wheat in the subordinate counties of Jinan and Wuding again failed, he ordered purchase in the abundant districts of Cao and Yi prefectures to supply relief.
translations.idiomatic: When wheat failed again in the counties subordinate to Jinan and Wuding, he ordered grain purchased in the abundant districts of Cao and Yi to supply relief.

sentences.zh: 上皆允之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved all.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all his requests.

sentences.zh: 直隸藁城知縣高崶請開臨淄、即墨、平陰、泰安、沂、費、滕、嶧諸縣銀、銅、鉛、鐵各礦，事下喀爾吉善勘奏，奏言：「東省拱衛神京，地跨四府八縣，形勢聯屬。

translations.literal: Gaocheng magistrate of Zhili Gao Feng asked to open silver, copper, lead, and iron mines in the counties Linzi, Jimo, Pingyin, Tai'an, Yi, Fei, Teng, and Yi; the matter was referred to Ka Erjishan for investigation and memorial; he memorialized, saying: "The eastern province guards the sacred capital, its territory spanning four prefectures and eight counties in linked strategic terrain.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Feng, magistrate of Gaocheng in Zhili, asked to open silver, copper, lead, and iron mines in Linzi, Jimo, Pingyin, Tai'an, Yi, Fei, Teng, and Yi counties. The matter was referred to Ka Erjishan for investigation; he memorialized: "Shandong guards the capital, its territory spanning four prefectures and eight counties in a single strategic block.

sentences.zh: 礦洞久經封禁，未便開採。

translations.literal: The mine shafts have long been sealed and forbidden; it is not convenient to open mining.
translations.idiomatic: The mine shafts have long been sealed, and it would be inadvisable to reopen them.

sentences.zh: 利之所在，眾必共趨。

translations.literal: Where profit lies, the multitude is sure to rush together.
translations.idiomatic: Where there is profit to be made, crowds will inevitably flock.

sentences.zh: 恐濟、武災區，沂、曹盜藪，別生事端，應仍封禁。」

translations.literal: I fear that in the disaster districts of Ji and Wu and the bandit lairs of Yi and Cao, other incidents may arise; the mines should remain sealed."
translations.idiomatic: I fear that in the stricken districts of Ji and Wu and the bandit-haunted regions of Yi and Cao, new troubles would arise; they should remain sealed."

sentences.zh: 上亦如其請。

translations.literal: The emperor also granted his request.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his request as well.

sentences.zh: 十一年，遷閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to be governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was appointed governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 台灣生番為亂，遣兵討之。

translations.literal: The aborigines of Taiwan rebelled, and he dispatched troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: When Taiwan's indigenous peoples rebelled, he sent troops to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「台灣流民日多，匪類肆竊，甚或恣行不法，民間謂為闖棍。

translations.literal: He memorialized, saying: "The floating population of Taiwan grows daily; ruffians steal at will, and some even act lawlessly—the people call them "gate-crashers.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Taiwan's floating population grows daily; ruffians steal freely, and some even break the law outright—locals call them "gate-crashers.

sentences.zh: 請令竊案再犯及闖棍治罪後，並逐回內地。」

translations.literal: I ask that after theft cases of repeat offenders and gate-crashers are punished, they all be expelled back to the interior."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that repeat thieves and gate-crashers, once sentenced, be expelled back to the mainland."

sentences.zh: 又請在台人民迎取眷屬，限一年給照過台。

translations.literal: He also asked that people in Taiwan be allowed to bring their families, with a limit of one year and passes to cross to the island.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that settlers in Taiwan be allowed to bring their families, with a one-year limit and official passes to cross the strait.

sentences.zh: 浙江處州總兵苗國琮請於官山種樹，儲戰船桅木之用，下喀爾吉善勘奏。

translations.literal: Chuzhou brigade commander Miao Guocong of Zhejiang asked to plant trees on Guanshan to store mast timber for warships; the matter was referred to Ka Erjishan for investigation and memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Miao Guocong, brigade commander of Chuzhou in Zhejiang, proposed planting trees on Guanshan to stock mast timber for warships; the matter was referred to Ka Erjishan for investigation.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「令有司種樹，須先糜帑，且必百十年後始中繩墨，日久稽察非易。

translations.literal: He memorialized, saying: "Ordering officials to plant trees would first consume treasury funds, and only after a hundred or ten years would they meet the standard; over time inspection would not be easy.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "If officials were ordered to plant trees, treasury funds would be consumed first, and usable timber would not be ready for a century; long-term oversight would be difficult.

sentences.zh: 不若許民自種，在官不費經營，而巨材可獲實用。」

translations.literal: It would be better to allow the people to plant on their own, costing the government no management, while large timber of real use could be obtained."
translations.idiomatic: It would be better to let the people plant on their own, at no cost to the government, while securing timber of real use."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: His proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 疏劾浙江巡撫常安貪婪，命大學士訥親往鞫得實，論如律。

translations.literal: He memorialized in impeachment of Zhejiang Governor Chang An for greed; Grand Secretary Neqin was ordered to go try the case and found it true; sentence followed the law.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached Zhejiang Governor Chang An for corruption; Grand Secretary Neqin was sent to investigate, found the charges true, and sentence followed the law.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其公直，加太子少保。

translations.literal: An edict praised his impartial uprightness and added the rank of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his impartial integrity and promoted him to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「寧海東湖舊與海通，宋後失修，飭府縣察形勢土性，導士民輸資築堤，撥為世業，定限昇科。」

translations.literal: He memorialized, saying: "The eastern lake of Ninghai formerly connected with the sea; after the Song it fell into disrepair. I ordered prefectures and counties to survey terrain and soil and guide gentry and people to contribute funds to build dikes, allotting the land as hereditary property with fixed limits for upgraded tax assessment."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Ninghai's eastern lake once connected to the sea; after the Song it fell into disrepair. I ordered prefectural and county officials to survey the terrain and guide local gentry and commoners to contribute funds for dikes, allotting reclaimed land as hereditary property with fixed tax upgrades."

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「勸課農桑，興修水利，務本之圖也。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed, saying: "To exhort and promote agriculture and sericulture and to undertake waterworks is the plan of honoring the fundamental.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "Encouraging farming and sericulture and repairing waterworks is the true path of honoring the fundamentals.

sentences.zh: 欣悅覽之！」

translations.literal: I read it with delight!"
translations.idiomatic: I read it with delight!"

sentences.zh: 十五年，加兵部尚書銜。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was given the rank of minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he received the rank of minister of War.

sentences.zh: 十六年，上南巡，蠲江南積逋二百餘萬，浙省無逋賦，亦特蠲本年正賦三十萬，制詩褒之。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, when the emperor toured the south, he remitted more than two million in accumulated arrears in Jiangnan; Zhejiang had no arrears, yet this year's regular tax of three hundred thousand was also specially remitted, and an imperial poem praised him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, during the southern tour, the emperor remitted more than two million taels of Jiangnan arrears; Zhejiang had none, yet its regular tax of three hundred thousand was also remitted, and an imperial poem praised him.

sentences.zh: 十七年，以年老乞休，溫詔慰留。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, citing old age he begged to retire; a warm edict comforted him and bade him remain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he asked to retire on account of age; a warm edict comforted him and urged him to stay.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「閩省產米少，本歲豐稔，宜為儲備。

translations.literal: He memorialized, saying: "Fujian produces little rice; this year's harvest has been abundant and reserves should be made.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Fujian produces little rice; this year's harvest has been good and reserves should be laid in.

sentences.zh: 請現存倉穀不及半者，令購足數；

translations.literal: I ask that where present granary grain is less than half, purchase be made to fill the quota.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that where granary stocks fall below half, purchases be made to fill the quota.

sentences.zh: 已及半而本地穀賤，亦以原存糶價買補。」

translations.literal: Where it is already half but local grain is cheap, also buy to replenish at the original sale price."
translations.idiomatic: Where stocks are already half but local grain is cheap, grain should also be bought at the original sale price to replenish stocks."

sentences.zh: 上是之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 漳州民蔡榮祖謀亂，事泄，捕獲，寘之法，予議敘。

translations.literal: Cai Rongzu of Zhangzhou plotted rebellion; when the affair leaked out he was captured and punished by law, and rewards for merit were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Rongzu of Zhangzhou plotted rebellion; when the plot was exposed he was captured, executed according to law, and rewards were granted for the merit of those who exposed him.

sentences.zh: 十九年，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was promoted to Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 上以八旗生齒日繁，許在京漢軍改入民籍，推行於各省。

translations.literal: Because the Eight Banners population in the capital grew daily, the emperor permitted Hanjun in Beijing to transfer to commoner registers, extending the policy to every province.
translations.idiomatic: As the Eight Banner population in the capital grew daily, the emperor permitted Hanjun in Beijing to enter the commoner registers, extending the policy to every province.

sentences.zh: 喀爾吉善與福州將軍新柱疏言：「漢軍原為民，無問世族、閒散，許入民籍。

translations.literal: Ka Erjishan and Fuzhou General Xin Zhu memorialized, saying: "Hanjun were originally commoners; whether of distinguished families or idle households, all may enter the commoner registers.
translations.idiomatic: Ka Erjishan and Fuzhou General Xin Zhu memorialized: "Hanjun were originally commoners; whether from distinguished families or idle households, all may enter the commoner registers.

sentences.zh: 如別無生計，坐補綠營糧缺。

translations.literal: If they have no other livelihood, let them fill Green Standard grain-ration vacancies.
translations.idiomatic: If they lack other livelihoods, let them fill vacancies in the Green Standard Army rations.

sentences.zh: 所遺馬、步甲，以滿洲兵坐補。」

translations.literal: The cavalry and infantry posts they vacate shall be filled by Manchu soldiers."
translations.idiomatic: The cavalry and infantry posts they vacate shall be filled by Manchu soldiers."

sentences.zh: 二十二年秋，病瘍，遣醫偕其子定敏馳視，賜人葠。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-second year he fell ill with ulcers; physicians were sent with his son Ding Min to hurry to him, and ginseng was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twenty-second year he fell ill with ulcers; physicians were sent with his son Ding Min to attend him, and ginseng was bestowed.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒，賜祭葬，諡莊恪。

translations.literal: Before long he died; sacrificial rites and burial were granted, and the posthumous title Zhuangke was conferred.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward; state sacrifices and burial honors were granted, and the posthumous title Zhuangke was conferred.

sentences.zh: 定長，喀爾吉善子。

translations.literal: Ding Zhang was Ka Erjishan's son.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Zhang was the son of Ka Erjishan.

sentences.zh: 初授內閣中書，遷侍讀。

translations.literal: At first he was appointed a secretary of the Grand Secretariat and was transferred to reader.
translations.idiomatic: He was first appointed secretary of the Grand Secretariat and later promoted to reader.

sentences.zh: 擢江南徐州知府。

translations.literal: He was promoted to prefect of Xuzhou in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to prefect of Xuzhou in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 四遷至巡撫，歷安徽、廣西、山西、貴州諸省。

translations.literal: After four promotions he became governor, serving in Anhui, Guangxi, Shanxi, and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: After four promotions he became governor, serving successively in Anhui, Guangxi, Shanxi, and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十八年，湖廣總督永常奏請於鄰省會哨，定長奏：「貴州與鄰省聯界，苗、夷環處。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Qianlong, Huguang Governor-General Yong Chang memorialized requesting joint patrols with neighboring provinces; Ding Zhang memorialized: "Guizhou borders neighboring provinces, with Miao and Yi all around.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Qianlong, Huguang Governor-General Yong Chang asked for joint patrols with neighboring provinces; Ding Zhang memorialized: "Guizhou borders neighboring provinces, with Miao and Yi peoples all around.

sentences.zh: 遽行會哨，苗性多猜，或滋事變。

translations.literal: If joint patrols are suddenly carried out, the Miao are much given to suspicion and may provoke incidents.
translations.idiomatic: If joint patrols were suddenly instituted, the suspicious Miao might provoke incidents.

sentences.zh: 請停止。」

translations.literal: I ask that they be stopped."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that they be suspended."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: His request was approved.

sentences.zh: 二十年，題請原任黔西知州黃秉忠入祀名宦，上以秉忠為總督廷桂父，瞻徇巿恩，降旨嚴斥。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he nominated former Qianxi prefect Huang Bingzhong for the shrine of eminent officials; because Huang Bingzhong was the father of Governor-General Ting Gui, the emperor said he was currying favor and sent a stern rebuke.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he nominated former Qianxi Prefect Huang Bingzhong for the shrine of eminent officials; because Huang was the father of Governor-General Ting Gui, the emperor denounced him for currying favor and sent a stern rebuke.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，上南巡，請入覲，命便道省喀爾吉善，賜詩褒寵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, when the emperor toured the south, Ding Zhang asked to be received in audience; he was ordered to visit Ka Erjishan by convenient route, and an imperial poem praised and favored him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, during the southern tour, Ding Zhang asked for an audience; he was told to visit Ka Erjishan by a convenient route and was honored with an imperial poem.

sentences.zh: 尋命與尚書劉統勳按雲貴總督恆文貪婪狀，即命署雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered with Minister Liu Tongxun to investigate the greed of Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Heng Wen, and was immediately appointed acting governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was ordered, together with Minister Liu Tongxun, to investigate Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Heng Wen for corruption, and was immediately appointed acting governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 調山西巡撫，未之任，丁父憂。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be governor of Shanxi but did not take up the post, returning home on account of mourning for his father.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to governor of Shanxi but had not taken up the post when he returned home to mourn his father.

sentences.zh: 旋授副都統銜，往西路軍營督屯田事。

translations.literal: Soon he was given the rank of vice censor-in-chief and sent to the western-route army camps to supervise military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was given the rank of vice censor-in-chief and sent to the western-route army camps to supervise military colonies.

sentences.zh: 補兵部侍郎，授福建巡撫，遷湖廣總督。

translations.literal: He was made vice minister of War, appointed governor of Fujian, and transferred to be governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice minister of War, then governor of Fujian, and later governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，卒，諭部議卹。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year he died; the ministries were ordered to deliberate on condolence grants.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year he died; the ministries were ordered to deliberate on condolence grants.

sentences.zh: 尋署總督高晉劾荊州副都統石亮衰庸，上責定長徇庇，罷卹典。

translations.literal: Soon Acting Governor-General Gao Jin impeached Jingzhou Vice Banner Commander Shi Liang as incompetent; the emperor blamed Ding Zhang for favoritism and canceled the condolence honors.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Acting Governor-General Gao Jin impeached Jingzhou Vice Banner Commander Shi Liang as incompetent; the emperor blamed Ding Zhang for shielding him and canceled the condolence honors.

sentences.zh: 鄂雲布，喀爾吉善孫。

translations.literal: E Yunbu was Ka Erjishan's grandson.
translations.idiomatic: E Yunbu was the grandson of Ka Erjishan.

sentences.zh: 初授筆帖式。

translations.literal: At first he was appointed a clerk.
translations.idiomatic: He was first appointed a clerk.

sentences.zh: 三遷工科給事中。

translations.literal: After three promotions he became a supervising censor of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: After three promotions he became a supervising censor of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，授陝西漢中知府。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he was appointed prefect of Hanzhong in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaqing he was appointed prefect of Hanzhong in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 上以鄂雲布喀爾吉善孫，家風具在，即擢甘肅西寧道。

translations.literal: Because E Yunbu was Ka Erjishan's grandson and the family tradition remained, he was immediately promoted to intendant of Xining in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Because E Yunbu was Ka Erjishan's grandson and the family tradition of integrity remained, he was immediately promoted to intendant of Xining in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 再遷江蘇布政使，護安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to provincial treasurer of Jiangsu and served as acting governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to provincial treasurer of Jiangsu and served as acting governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 旋以秋審諸案原擬緩決，刑部多改情實，責鄂雲布寬縱，下吏部議降調，命留任。

translations.literal: Soon, because in autumn review cases originally proposed for suspended execution the Ministry of Punishments mostly changed them to cases of true circumstances, E Yunbu was blamed for leniency; the Ministry of Personnel recommended demotion and transfer, but he was ordered to remain in office.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, because in autumn review cases originally proposed for suspended execution the Ministry of Punishments had mostly changed them to cases warranting execution, E Yunbu was blamed for leniency; the Ministry of Personnel recommended demotion, but he was ordered to remain in office.

sentences.zh: 尋遷貴州巡撫，年老召還，鄂雲布聞命即行。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to be governor of Guizhou; when old age was cited and he was recalled, E Yunbu set out as soon as he heard the order.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to governor of Guizhou; when recall on account of age was ordered, E Yunbu set out immediately upon hearing the news.

sentences.zh: 上聞之，不懌，下吏部議，奪官，授筆帖式，賞藍翎侍衛，充葉爾羌辦事大臣。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of this he was displeased; the Ministry of Personnel was ordered to deliberate; he was stripped of office, appointed a clerk, granted the rank of blue-button imperial bodyguard, and sent as commissioner to Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard this he was displeased; the Ministry of Personnel recommended dismissal; he was stripped of office, appointed a clerk, granted the rank of blue-button imperial bodyguard, and sent as commissioner to Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 旋卒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: =雅爾圖=雅爾圖，蒙古鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Ya Er Tu: Ya Er Tu, a Mongol of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Ya Er Tu, a Mongol of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年，自筆帖式入貲授主事，分工部。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng, from clerk he entered by purchase and was appointed a director, assigned to the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yongzheng he rose from clerk by purchase to director in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 再遷郎中。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to director.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted again to director.

sentences.zh: 十三年，授鑲藍旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was appointed vice commander of the Bordered Blue Banner Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was appointed vice commander of the Bordered Blue Banner Manchus.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，疏言：「京員無養廉，請將戶部餘平銀給部院辦事官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he memorialized, saying: "Capital officials have no integrity-nourishment allowances; I ask that the Ministry of Revenue's surplus ping silver be given to officials handling business in the ministries and courts.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianlong he memorialized: "Capital officials receive no integrity-nourishment allowances; I ask that the Ministry of Revenue's surplus ping silver be distributed to officials in the ministries and courts.

sentences.zh: 八旗參佐等員視步軍營例，予空糧。」

translations.literal: Eight Banner adjutants and similar officers should, following the Metropolitan Infantry example, receive empty-ration allowances."
translations.idiomatic: Eight Banner adjutants and similar officers should, following the Metropolitan Infantry precedent, receive empty-ration allowances."

sentences.zh: 如所議。

translations.literal: As proposed.
translations.idiomatic: His proposals were adopted.

sentences.zh: 師徵準噶爾，授參贊大臣。

translations.literal: When the army campaigned against the Zunghars, he was appointed assisting commander.
translations.idiomatic: When the army campaigned against the Zunghars, he was appointed assisting commander.

sentences.zh: 三年，命暫管定邊副將軍印。

translations.literal: In the third year he was ordered temporarily to hold the seal of the deputy general of the Pacification Frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was ordered temporarily to hold the seal of the Pacification Frontier deputy general.

sentences.zh: 四年，召授左副都御史，遷兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was summoned and appointed left vice censor-in-chief, then transferred to vice minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was summoned, appointed left vice censor-in-chief, and transferred to vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 河南新鄉民及伊陽教匪為亂，命往按治，就授河南巡撫。

translations.literal: The people of Xinxiang in Henan and the religious bandits of Yiyang rebelled; he was ordered to go investigate and pacify, and was thereupon appointed governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: When the people of Xinxiang in Henan and the religious rebels of Yiyang rose in revolt, he was sent to investigate and pacify them and was appointed governor of Henan on the spot.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「河南多盜，不逞之民陰為之主，俗謂'窩家'。

translations.literal: He memorialized, saying: "Henan has many bandits; unruly people secretly act as their masters, commonly called "nest households.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Henan has many bandits; unruly men secretly shelter them, in what is called a "nest household.

sentences.zh: 保甲、甲長等畏窩家甚於官法。

translations.literal: Community heads and tithing chiefs fear nest households more than official law.
translations.idiomatic: Community heads and tithing chiefs fear nest households more than they fear the law.

sentences.zh: 大河以南，深山邃谷。

translations.literal: South of the great river are deep mountains and remote valleys.
translations.idiomatic: South of the Yellow River lie deep mountains and remote valleys.

sentences.zh: 民以防鳥獸為名，皆有刀械。

translations.literal: The people, in the name of guarding against birds and beasts, all keep blades and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: People there, claiming to guard against birds and beasts, all keep blades and weapons.

sentences.zh: 惑於邪教，懷私角斗，何所不為。

translations.literal: Bewitched by heterodox teachings, they harbor private grudges and fight duels—what will they not do?
translations.idiomatic: Led astray by heterodox cults and nursing private grudges, they duel without restraint—what will they not do?

sentences.zh: 如梁朝鳳、梁週、張位等輩，黨類甚多，愚民易遭煽惑。

translations.literal: Men such as Liang Chaofeng, Liang Zhou, and Zhang Wei have many followers, and foolish people are easily incited.
translations.idiomatic: Men such as Liang Chaofeng, Liang Zhou, and Zhang Wei have large followings, and simple people are easily incited.

sentences.zh: 與其發覺後儘置諸法，何如於未發覺前設法銷散。

translations.literal: Rather than after discovery putting them all to the law, how much better before discovery to devise means to disperse them?
translations.idiomatic: Rather than punish them all after discovery, how much better to disperse them before trouble breaks out?

sentences.zh: 文武會遣兵役搜查，仍令自首免罪。」

translations.literal: Civil and military officials should jointly send soldiers to search, while still allowing voluntary surrender to escape punishment."
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials should jointly send troops to search, while still offering amnesty to those who surrender."

sentences.zh: 又言：「各省提鎮以下官皆有伴擋兵丁及各色工匠，一營有數名虛糧，即少數名額兵。

translations.literal: He also said: "Below the provincial commanders-in-chief in every province, officials all have attendant soldiers and craftsmen of various kinds; in one camp several empty rations mean several fewer quota soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Below the provincial commanders-in-chief, officials keep attendant soldiers and craftsmen of every kind; several empty rations in one camp mean several fewer soldiers on the rolls.

sentences.zh: 請照官級核定數目，不得虛佔兵額。」

translations.literal: I ask that numbers be fixed according to official rank, and that quota soldiers not be falsely occupied."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that numbers be fixed according to official rank and that troop quotas not be falsely occupied."

sentences.zh: 俱下部議行。

translations.literal: All were referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: All were referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 五年，奏報捕得女教匪首一枝花，命議敘。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he memorialized reporting the capture of the female religious bandit leader Yizhihua; rewards for merit were ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he reported the capture of the female cult leader Yizhihua; rewards for merit were ordered.

sentences.zh: 尋諭河南止設河北、南陽二鎮，與巡撫不相統屬，視山西例兼提督銜。

translations.literal: Soon he was instructed that Henan should have only the Hebei and Nanyang garrisons, not subordinate to the governor, and following the Shanxi precedent he should also hold the rank of provincial commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was instructed that Henan should have only the Hebei and Nanyang garrisons, independent of the governor, and that following the Shanxi precedent he should also hold the rank of provincial commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 疏陳整飭營務：足兵額，勤差操，明賞罰，練技藝，整軍械，重兵食，驗馬匹，謹守望，嚴約束；

translations.literal: He memorialized on rectifying camp affairs: filling troop quotas, diligent drill and duty, clarifying rewards and punishments, practicing skills, maintaining arms, stressing military rations, inspecting horses, strict watch, tight discipline.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized on rectifying military affairs: filling troop quotas, diligent drill and duty, clear rewards and punishments, practiced skills, maintained arms, adequate rations, inspected horses, strict watches, and tight discipline.

sentences.zh: 並請以州縣民壯之半交駐防汛弁操練；

translations.literal: He also asked that half the local militia of prefectures and counties be handed to garrison officers on flood defense for training.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that half the local militia of prefectures and counties be assigned to flood-defense garrison officers for training.

sentences.zh: 並戒兵民和衷，不得偏袒，平時試習騎射，期於嫺熟：俱如所請行。

translations.literal: He also warned soldiers and civilians to work in harmony without partiality, and in peacetime to practice mounted archery until skilled: all as requested.
translations.idiomatic: He also urged soldiers and civilians to cooperate without favoritism and to practice mounted archery in peacetime until skilled: all as he requested.

sentences.zh: 三月，疏言：「河南上年霪雨，省城多積水。

translations.literal: In the third month he memorialized, saying: "Last year in Henan there was prolonged rain and the provincial capital had much standing water.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he memorialized: "Last year prolonged rain left much standing water in the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 臣令淺處濬深，窄處開寬。

translations.literal: I ordered shallow places dredged deeper and narrow places widened.
translations.idiomatic: I ordered shallow sections dredged deeper and narrow sections widened.

sentences.zh: 為合城受水之區通溝建閘，時其蓄洩。

translations.literal: For the area receiving the city's water I opened connecting ditches and built sluice gates to regulate storage and release.
translations.idiomatic: For the city's catchment I opened connecting ditches and built sluice gates to regulate storage and release.

sentences.zh: 養魚植木，以利民用。」

translations.literal: Fish were raised and trees planted to benefit the people."
translations.idiomatic: Fish were raised and trees planted for public benefit."

sentences.zh: 又言：「河南上年被水，奉命濬省城乾河涯及淮、潁、汝、蔡各水。

translations.literal: He also said: "Last year Henan suffered flooding; I was ordered to dredge the dry river banks of the provincial capital and the Huai, Ying, Ru, and Cai waters.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Last year's flooding in Henan led to orders to dredge the dry river banks of the capital and the Huai, Ying, Ru, and Cai waterways.

sentences.zh: 目前二麥成熟，農務正殷，餘請概停開浚。」

translations.literal: At present the second wheat crop is ripe and farm work is pressing; the rest of the dredging should altogether be suspended."
translations.idiomatic: The second wheat crop is now ripe and farm work is pressing; the remaining dredging should be suspended."

sentences.zh: 上從之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 又奏言：「現獲盜百餘，多系鄰省人，臣迭飭員弁分路訪緝。

translations.literal: He also memorialized, saying: "More than a hundred bandits now captured are mostly from neighboring provinces; I have repeatedly ordered officers to search and seize by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Of more than a hundred bandits now captured, most are from neighboring provinces; I have repeatedly ordered officers to search along separate routes.

sentences.zh: 出省捕盜，例須赴地方官掛號，盜聞而潛逃，請得迳行往捕。」

translations.literal: When pursuing bandits outside the province, by rule one must register with local officials, and bandits hear and flee; I ask permission to go directly to capture them."
translations.idiomatic: When pursuing bandits outside the province, officers must register with local officials by rule, giving bandits time to flee; I ask permission to pursue and capture directly."

sentences.zh: 上命勉為之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered him to do his best.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told him to do his best.

sentences.zh: 六年，又奏言：「河南界連五省，西南伏牛、嵩山、桐柏等山，支干交錯，地多林木，易於藏盜。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he again memorialized, saying: "Henan borders five provinces; in the southwest the Funiu, Song, and Tongbai mountains and their branches interweave; the land has much forest and easily hides bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he again memorialized: "Henan borders five provinces; in the southwest the Funiu, Song, and Tongbai ranges and their branches interweave; the wooded terrain easily hides bandits.

sentences.zh: 請每歲秋冬，與聯界各省文武訂期巡察。」

translations.literal: I ask that each year in autumn and winter, with civil and military officials of bordering provinces, a date be fixed for joint patrol."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that each autumn and winter civil and military officials of bordering provinces fix dates for joint patrols."

sentences.zh: 上命如所請行。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered implementation as requested.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered implementation as requested.

sentences.zh: 七年，奏言開、歸等處積水，無妨田畝，上責其掩飾。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he memorialized that accumulated water in Kaifeng, Guide, and other places did not harm the fields; the emperor blamed him for concealment.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he reported that standing water in Kaifeng, Guide, and other places did not harm the fields; the emperor accused him of concealment.

sentences.zh: 尋又奏：「河南地平土鬆，水利誠不如東南之通達。

translations.literal: Soon he again memorialized: "Henan has level land and loose soil; waterworks are truly not so connected as in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he again memorialized: "Henan has level land and loose soil; its waterworks are truly less interconnected than in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 開、歸等處地當下游，夏秋大雨，澗水匯注。

translations.literal: Kaifeng, Guide, and other places lie in the downstream reaches; in summer and autumn heavy rains cause stream water to converge and pour in.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng, Guide, and other places lie downstream, where heavy summer and autumn rains send converging streams pouring into them.

sentences.zh: 積水未消，多系鄰近黃河州縣。

translations.literal: Standing water has not subsided, and much involves neighboring Yellow River prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: The standing water has not yet drained away, and much of the area lies in prefectures and counties near the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 歷來豁免錢糧，於民生並無妨礙。

translations.literal: Grain and tax remissions have been granted through the ages, and this has not harmed the people's livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Tax and grain remissions have been granted there for generations without harm to the people's livelihood.

sentences.zh: 且土性咸鹵，難以種植。

translations.literal: Moreover the soil is saline and alkaline, and difficult to plant.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the soil is saline and alkaline and difficult to farm.

sentences.zh: 未便一律疏泄，以損田廬。」

translations.literal: It is not convenient to drain uniformly, lest fields and dwellings be harmed."
translations.idiomatic: Uniform drainage would not be advisable, for it would damage fields and homesteads."

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「實難宣洩，朕不怪汝。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "It is truly hard to release and drain; I do not blame you.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "It is indeed difficult to drain the water—I do not blame you for it.

sentences.zh: 若避而為飾辭則不可。」

translations.literal: But if you evade and use polished words, that will not do."
translations.idiomatic: But evasive polished words will not be tolerated."

sentences.zh: 八年，自陳「戇直致被人言。」

translations.literal: In the eighth year he reported himself: "My blunt straightforwardness has led to criticism."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he submitted that his blunt honesty had brought criticism upon him."

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「汝必欲以豐年為政效，水旱漠不關心。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "You insist on taking bumper harvests as your proof of achievement, and care nothing about flood or drought.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "You wish to take good harvests alone as proof of achievement and show no concern for flood or drought.

sentences.zh: 此奏殊屬客氣。」

translations.literal: This memorial is greatly a matter of outward politeness."
translations.idiomatic: This memorial is quite disingenuous."

sentences.zh: 命來京，改授鑲藍旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: He was ordered to come to the capital and was reassigned as vice lieutenant-general of the Bordered Blue Banner Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to the capital and reassigned as vice lieutenant-general of the Bordered Blue Banner Manchus.

sentences.zh: 授刑部侍郎，調吏部。

translations.literal: He was appointed vice minister of Punishments and transferred to Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice minister of Punishments and then transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十二年，命往山西按治安邑、万泉民亂，中途稱病，上責其逗遛，命解任。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was ordered to go to Shanxi to pacify disturbances among the people in Anyi and Wanquan; midway he claimed illness; the emperor blamed his dallying and ordered removal from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was ordered to Shanxi to pacify disturbances in Anyi and Wanquan; midway he pleaded illness, and the emperor, blaming his delay, ordered his dismissal.

sentences.zh: 尋起授內閣侍讀學士，复擢兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon after he was restored and appointed reader of the Grand Secretariat, and again was promoted to vice minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon restored to office as a reader of the Grand Secretariat and promoted again to vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 十三年，調倉場侍郎，兼正紅旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to grain storehouse vice minister and also served as vice lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to grain storehouse vice minister while also serving as vice lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner Manchus.

sentences.zh: 迭署戶部侍郎、步軍統領。

translations.literal: He repeatedly served as acting vice minister of Revenue and metropolitan garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: He served repeatedly as acting vice minister of Revenue and commander of the metropolitan garrison.

sentences.zh: 十八年，因疾解任。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was relieved of office owing to illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he retired from office due to illness.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the thirty-second year.

sentences.zh: =晏斯盛=晏斯盛，字虞際，江西新喻人。

translations.literal: Yan Sisheng: Yan Sisheng, courtesy name Yuji, a native of Xinyu in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Sisheng, courtesy name Yuji, was a native of Xinyu in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十九年，舉鄉試第一。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year of Kangxi he ranked first in the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year of the Kangxi reign (1720) he placed first in the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 六十年，成進士，改庶吉士。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he passed the jinshi examination and was transferred to Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: The following year (1721) he passed the jinshi examination and entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，授檢討。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he was appointed reviser.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Yongzheng reign (1723) he was appointed reviser.

sentences.zh: 五年，考選山西道御史。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was selected by examination as censor of the Shanxi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1727) he was selected by examination as censor of the Shanxi circuit.

sentences.zh: 鑲紅旗巡役，以斯盛從騎驚突，拘辱之。

translations.literal: A patrolman of the Bordered Red Banner, because Sisheng's attendant riders startled and rushed forward, seized and humiliated him.
translations.idiomatic: A patrolman of the Bordered Red Banner seized and humiliated Sisheng when his attendant riders startled and rushed forward.

sentences.zh: 斯盛以聞，命治罪。

translations.literal: Sisheng reported it, and punishment was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Sisheng reported the matter, and the offender was ordered punished.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「各州縣立社倉，原以通濟豐歉。

translations.literal: In a memorial he said: "Prefectures and counties establish community granaries originally to extend aid through plenty and dearth.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Community granaries in prefectures and counties were originally meant to aid people through times of plenty and scarcity.

sentences.zh: 貧民借穀，石收息十升。

translations.literal: Poor people borrowing grain pay interest of ten sheng per shi.
translations.idiomatic: When the poor borrow grain, interest of ten sheng per shi is charged.

sentences.zh: 如遇歉，當不取其息。」

translations.literal: If scarcity is encountered, the interest should not be taken."
translations.idiomatic: In times of scarcity, no interest should be collected."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 九年，督貴州學政。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he supervised educational affairs in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he served as educational commissioner of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 遷鴻臚寺少卿。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，擢安徽布政使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he was promoted to financial commissioner of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Qianlong reign (1736) he was promoted to financial commissioner of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「各省水旱災，督撫題報，應即遴員發倉穀治賑，仍於四十五日限內題明應否加賑。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "When flood and drought disasters occur in each province, governors and governors-general report by memorial; officials should immediately be selected to distribute granary grain for relief, and within the forty-five-day limit it should be reported whether additional relief should be granted.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "When provinces suffer flood or drought, governors should immediately dispatch officials to distribute granary grain for relief upon reporting the disaster, and within forty-five days indicate whether additional relief is warranted.

sentences.zh: 其當免錢糧，將丁銀統入地糧覈算，限兩月題報。

translations.literal: As for tax and grain that should be remitted, poll tax silver should be combined into land tax for calculation, with report within two months.
translations.idiomatic: Tax and grain remissions should be calculated by combining poll tax into land tax assessments, with memorials due within two months.

sentences.zh: 或分年帶徵，或按分蠲免，請旨遵行。」

translations.literal: Whether collected over years in arrears or remitted proportionally, imperial decision should be requested for compliance."
translations.idiomatic: Whether arrears are collected over several years or remitted by proportional shares, memorials should request the throne's decision for implementation."

sentences.zh: 三年，疏言：「安徽被災州縣，倉儲不敷賑糶，請留未被災州縣漕米備賑。」

translations.literal: In the third year he memorialized: "In Anhui's disaster-stricken prefectures and counties, storehouse reserves are insufficient for relief sale; retained tribute grain from undamaged prefectures and counties is requested for relief reserve."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he memorialized that disaster-stricken counties in Anhui lacked sufficient granary reserves for relief sales and asked to retain tribute grain from unaffected counties for emergency relief."

sentences.zh: 四年，奏言：「江北向多遊食之人，每遇歉歲，輕去其鄉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he memorialized: "North of the Yangzi there have long been many wandering laborers; each time a poor year comes they lightly leave their villages.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he reported that north of the Yangzi had long had many migrant laborers who readily left their homes in lean years.

sentences.zh: 惟寓賑於工，人必爭趨。

translations.literal: Only by embedding relief in public works will people surely compete to come.
translations.idiomatic: Only by combining relief with public works will people flock to stay.

sentences.zh: 鳳陽、潁州以睢水為經，廬州以巢湖為緯，六安、滁、泗舊有堤堰，請援淮、揚水利例，動帑修濬。」

translations.literal: Fengyang and Yingzhou take the Sui River as warp, Luzhou takes Chaohu Lake as weft; Lu'an, Chu, and Si had old dikes and sluices; he asked to follow the Huai and Yangzhou waterworks precedent and draw funds for repair and dredging."
translations.idiomatic: Fengyang and Yingzhou should be governed along the Sui River, Luzhou along Chaohu Lake; Lu'an, Chu, and Si had old dikes and sluices, and he asked to follow the Huai-Yangzhou waterworks model and allocate funds for repairs and dredging."

sentences.zh: 皆從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved all of them.

sentences.zh: 七年，擢山東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted to governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1742) he was appointed governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 山東有老瓜賊，巡撫硃定元令汛兵巡大道。

translations.literal: Shandong had Old Melon bandits; Governor Zhu Dingyuan ordered patrol troops to guard the main roads.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong had a band of Old Melon bandits; Governor Zhu Dingyuan ordered patrol troops to guard the main roads.

sentences.zh: 斯盛疏言：「賊情狡獪，大道巡嚴，必潛移僻路；

translations.literal: Sisheng memorialized: "The bandits are cunning; if main roads are strictly patrolled they will surely shift to byways;
translations.idiomatic: Sisheng memorialized: "The bandits are cunning; strict patrols on the main roads will only drive them onto back paths;

sentences.zh: 或假僧道技流，伏匿村落。

translations.literal: or they may pose as monks, Daoists, or itinerant performers and hide concealed in villages.
translations.idiomatic: or they may pose as monks, Daoists, or itinerant performers and hide in villages.

sentences.zh: 應令州縣督佐雜分地巡察。」

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties should be ordered to divide the territory among supervisors, aides, and clerks for patrol."
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties should divide the territory among supervisors, aides, and clerks for patrol duty."

sentences.zh: 又奏：「邪教惑民，莫如創立教會，陽修善事。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Heretical sects deceive the people; nothing is worse than founding congregations while outwardly doing good works.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Heretical sects deceive the people most effectively by founding congregations while outwardly doing good works.

sentences.zh: 此倡彼和，日傳日廣，大為風教之害。

translations.literal: One starts, another echoes; spreading day by day, greatly harming customs and education.
translations.idiomatic: One voice leads and others follow; the movement spreads daily and greatly harms public morals.

sentences.zh: 盡法深求，株連蔓延，恐生事端。

translations.literal: Pursuing to the full extent of the law with deep investigations, implicating others in spreading cases, may breed incidents.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing every case to the full extent of the law with deep investigations and spreading imputations may provoke unrest.

sentences.zh: 請將創教授徒為首者如法捕治，被誘者薄懲，出首者免究。」

translations.literal: He asked that founders and teachers be seized and punished according to law, the deceived lightly punished, and those who surrender exempted from prosecution."
translations.idiomatic: He asked that founders and teachers be arrested and punished according to law, the misled lightly punished, and those who come forward exempted from prosecution."

sentences.zh: 上從其請。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his request.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted his request.

sentences.zh: 尋以萊州被水，請暫禁米出海。

translations.literal: Soon, because Laizhou suffered flooding, he asked temporarily to forbid rice export by sea.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, because Laizhou had suffered flooding, he asked temporarily to forbid rice exports by sea.
