translations.idiomatic: Under Yongzheng he was promoted to prefect of Fenzhou in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十五年，授河南驛鹽道。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Qianlong he was appointed intendant of postal stations and salt in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Qianlong, he was appointed intendant of postal stations and salt for Henan.

sentences.zh: 擢安徽按察使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Judicial Commissioner of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to judicial commissioner of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，服闋，補貴州按察使。

translations.literal: He mourned his mother; when the mourning period ended, he was appointed Judicial Commissioner of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning his mother and completing the mourning period, he was appointed judicial commissioner of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，擢湖南布政使，署巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was promoted to Financial Commissioner of Hunan and served as acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was made financial commissioner of Hunan and served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 總督碩色劾應階子甘肅東樂知縣琇附驛寄家書，應階不檢舉，上特命降調。

translations.literal: Governor-General Suose memorialized that Yingjie's son Xi, magistrate of Dongle in Gansu, had sent family letters by courier post, and that Yingjie had failed to report it; the emperor specially ordered his demotion and transfer.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Suose impeached Yingjie's son Xi, magistrate of Dongle in Gansu, for sending family letters through the courier service, and charged Yingjie with failing to report it; the emperor specially ordered him demoted and transferred.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，補江南常鎮揚道。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was appointed to the Chang-Zhen-Yang Circuit of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was appointed intendant of the Chang-Zhen-Yang Circuit in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 再遷山東布政使。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Financial Commissioner of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to financial commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，遷貴州巡撫，調山東。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was transferred to Governor of Guizhou, then transferred to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was made governor of Guizhou, then transferred to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 疏請濬荊山橋舊河，洩積水。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting dredging the old river at Jingshan Bridge to drain accumulated water.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized asking that the old channel at Jingshan Bridge be dredged to drain off standing water.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，疏言：「武城運河東岸牛蹄窩、祝官屯，西岸蔡河陂水匯注，俱為堤隔，浸灌民田，請各建閘啟閉。」

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he memorialized: "On the eastern bank of the Wucheng Canal at Niuqiwo and Zhuguantun, and on the western bank at Caihepo, water converges; all is blocked by dikes and inundates farmland. I request that sluice gates be built at each place for opening and closing."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he memorialized: "At Niuqiwo and Zhuguantun on the east bank of the Wucheng Canal, and at Caihepo on the west bank, waters converge but are blocked by dikes and flood the fields. I ask that sluice gates be built at each site so they may be opened and closed as needed."

sentences.zh: 均如所議。

translations.literal: All was approved as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved all of it as proposed.

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he memorialized: "Militia in the various districts and counties exist in name but not in fact. Order subordinates to eliminate the old and weak, select the strong, and train them in musketry so they are no different from regular troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year he memorialized: "District and county militia exist only on paper. I have ordered my subordinates to weed out the old and weak, select able-bodied men, and train them in muskets so they are indistinguishable from regular troops.

sentences.zh: 不增糧餉，省得精壯三千三百餘名。」

translations.literal: Without increasing grain pay, more than 3,300 strong men were saved."
translations.idiomatic: Without adding to grain allowances, he saved more than 3,300 able-bodied men."

sentences.zh: 得旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: He received an imperial commendation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued a decree commending him.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，疏言：「武定濱海，屢有水患：一在徒駭尾閭不暢，一在鉤盤淤塞未開。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he memorialized: "Wuding borders the sea and suffers repeated floods: one cause is that the tail outlet of the Tuhe is obstructed; another is that the Goupan is silted and unopened.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year he memorialized: "Wuding lies on the coast and has suffered repeated floods: one problem is that the lower outlet of the Tuhe River does not flow freely; another is that the Goupan River is silted up and has not been reopened.

sentences.zh: 徒駭上游寬百餘丈，至霑化入海處僅十餘丈，紆回曲折，歸海遲延。

translations.literal: The upper Tuhe is more than a hundred zhang wide, but at Zhanhua where it enters the sea it is only a little over ten zhang; winding and meandering, its return to the sea is delayed.
translations.idiomatic: The upper Tuhe is more than a hundred zhang across, yet at Zhanhua, where it reaches the sea, it narrows to little more than ten zhang; twisting and turning, it reaches the sea only slowly.

sentences.zh: 徒駭舊有漫口，徑二十五里，寬至四五十丈，水漲賴以宣洩。

translations.literal: The Tuhe once had overflow outlets twenty-five li long and forty to fifty zhang wide, relied on for discharge when water rose.
translations.idiomatic: The Tuhe once had overflow channels twenty-five li long and forty to fifty zhang wide, which served to release floodwater when the river rose.

sentences.zh: 若就此開濬，庶歸海得以迅速。

translations.literal: If dredged at this point, the return to the sea could be made swift.
translations.idiomatic: If dredged at this point, the river could reach the sea much more quickly.

sentences.zh: 又有八方泊為眾水所匯，伏秋霖雨，下游阻滯，淹及民田。

translations.literal: There is also Bafang Marsh, where many waters converge; during the autumn rains the lower reaches are blocked and farmland is inundated.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Bafang Marsh, where many streams converge; when the autumn rains come, the lower course backs up and floods the fields.

sentences.zh: 泊東北為古鉤盤河，經一百三十餘裡，久成湮廢。

translations.literal: Northeast of the marsh lies the ancient Goupan River, more than a hundred and thirty li long, long abandoned and silted over.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast of the marsh runs the ancient Goupan River, more than a hundred and thirty li in length, long since silted up and abandoned.

sentences.zh: 若就此開濬，引水入海，則上游不致停蓄，積水亦可順流而下。」

translations.literal: If dredged here and the water led to the sea, the upper reaches would not stagnate and accumulated water could flow down smoothly."
translations.idiomatic: If dredged here and the water directed to the sea, the upper course would no longer hold back water, and standing floodwater could run off downstream."

sentences.zh: 皆如所請。

translations.literal: All was granted as requested.
translations.idiomatic: Everything was approved as he had asked.

sentences.zh: 調福建，三十三年，擢閩浙總督，加太子太保。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Fujian; in the thirty-third year he was promoted to Governor-General of Min-Zhe and given the rank of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Fujian, and in the thirty-third year was promoted to governor-general of Min-Zhe and given the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，劾興泉永道蔡琛貪鄙，論如律。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he impeached Cai Chen, intendant of the Xing-Quan-Yong Circuit, for greed and baseness; he was sentenced according to law.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year he impeached Cai Chen, intendant of the Xing-Quan-Yong Circuit, for greed and corruption, and Cai was punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 調漕運總督，奏糧道專司漕務，無地方之責，令親押赴淮，不得轉委丞倅。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Grain Transport Governor-General and memorialized that the grain circuit commissioner should handle grain transport alone, with no local administrative duties, and must personally escort shipments to the Huai, not delegate to assistant officials.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to grain transport governor-general, he memorialized that the grain circuit commissioner should handle transport duties only, without local administrative responsibilities, and must personally escort grain to the Huai rather than delegate the task to deputies.

sentences.zh: 召授刑部尚書，調左都御史。

translations.literal: He was summoned and appointed Minister of Punishments, then transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to the capital, appointed minister of punishments, and then transferred to left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，以原品休致。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year he retired at his original rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year he retired at his original rank.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after.

sentences.zh: =王檢=王檢，字思及，山東福山人。

translations.literal: Wang Jian: Wang Jian, courtesy name Siji, a native of Fushan in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian, a native of Fushan in Shandong, bore the courtesy name Siji.

sentences.zh: 父趯，官太常寺卿。

translations.literal: His father Yue served as Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yue was minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 檢，雍正十一年進士，改庶吉士。

translations.literal: Jian passed the jinshi examination in the eleventh year of Yongzheng and was made a Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: Jian became a jinshi in the eleventh year of Yongzheng and was appointed a Hanlin bachelor.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，授編修。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianlong he was appointed a compiler in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 大考四等，休致。

translations.literal: In the grand evaluation he received fourth class and retired.
translations.idiomatic: Rated fourth class in the grand evaluation, he retired from office.

sentences.zh: 十三年，上幸闕里，召試，复授編修。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, when the emperor visited Qufu, Jian was summoned for examination and was again appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, when the emperor visited Qufu, he was summoned for an examination and reappointed compiler.

sentences.zh: 十四年，授直隸河間知府，遷甘肅涼莊道。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed prefect of Hejian in Zhili and was transferred to the Liang-Zhuang Circuit in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was made prefect of Hejian in Zhili, then transferred to intendant of the Liang-Zhuang Circuit in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 以官河間有政聲，即調直隸霸昌道。

translations.literal: Because of his good reputation while serving at Hejian, he was immediately transferred to the Ba-Chang Circuit in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On account of his good reputation at Hejian, he was promptly transferred to intendant of the Ba-Chang Circuit in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 累擢安徽按察使。

translations.literal: He was successively promoted to Judicial Commissioner of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in stages to judicial commissioner of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 奏：「外任官員眷屬外，定例州縣家人二十名，府道以上遞加十名，違者降級。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "For officials serving outside the capital, apart from family members, the fixed quota is twenty household servants for district and county officials, with ten added at each level from prefecture and circuit upward; violators are demoted.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "For officials in the provinces, apart from family members, the regulation sets twenty household servants for district and county magistrates, with ten more added at each level from prefecture and circuit upward; violators are to be demoted.

sentences.zh: 定額本寬，近則州縣一署幾至百人，毋論招搖滋弊，即養廉亦不足供，請申明定例，違數詳參。」

translations.literal: The quota is already generous, yet lately a single district or county office may reach nearly a hundred; setting aside the abuses that breed corruption, even the integrity stipend is insufficient to support them. I request that the regulation be restated and excess numbers be reported in detail for impeachment."
translations.idiomatic: The quota is already generous, yet lately a single county or district office may employ nearly a hundred servants; quite apart from the corruption this invites, even the integrity stipend cannot cover the cost. I ask that the regulation be reaffirmed and that excess numbers be reported for formal impeachment."

sentences.zh: 又奏：「皖城濱臨大江，歲多劫案，請加重沿江乘危搶奪舊例，邊海有犯視此。」

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Wancheng lies on the great river and sees many robbery cases each year. I request heavier penalties under the old regulations for seizing goods in peril along the river; offenders on the coast should be treated the same."
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Wancheng stands on the Yangtze and suffers many robberies each year. I ask that the old penalties for seizing goods from vessels in distress along the river be increased, and that coastal offenders be punished by the same standard."

sentences.zh: 均得旨允行。

translations.literal: All received imperial approval and was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all of it for implementation.

sentences.zh: 調直隸，又調山西。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Zhili, then again to Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Zhili and then to Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，遷廣西布政使，調甘肅。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was transferred to Financial Commissioner of Guangxi, then transferred to Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was made financial commissioner of Guangxi, then transferred to Gansu.

sentences.zh: 奏：「各省大計舉劾，例由籓司主稿。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "In the triennial evaluation and impeachment in each province, the provincial treasurer normally drafts the memorial by regulation.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "In each province's triennial evaluation and impeachment, the provincial treasurer normally drafts the report by regulation.

sentences.zh: 請嗣後籓司新任，得援督撫例展限三月，以重考核。」

translations.literal: I request that hereafter newly appointed provincial treasurers be allowed, following the governors' and governors-general's precedent, a three-month extension so that evaluation may be given greater weight."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that newly appointed provincial treasurers hereafter be granted a three-month extension, following the precedent set for governors and governors-general, so that the evaluation may be conducted more thoroughly."

sentences.zh: 二十九年，擢湖北巡撫，署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was promoted to Governor of Hubei and served as acting Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he was made governor of Hubei and served as acting governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 以前巡撫愛必達請於沔陽新堤設文泉縣治，地處低窪，城倉庫獄俱未興工，且於民情未便，奏請裁撤，移沔陽州同駐新堤，下部議行。

translations.literal: The former governor Aibida had requested establishing the seat of Wenquan County at Xindi in Mianyang; the land was low and marshy, the city wall, granary, and prison had not yet been built, and it was inconvenient for the people. Jian memorialized requesting its abolition and that the Mianyang subprefect be moved to garrison Xindi; the ministry deliberated and implemented it.
translations.idiomatic: The previous governor Aibida had proposed establishing Wenquan County at Xindi in Mianyang, but the site was low and marshy, the city wall, granary, and jail had never been built, and it was ill suited to local conditions. Jian memorialized asking that the county be abolished and the Mianyang subprefect moved to Xindi; the ministry approved and carried it out.

sentences.zh: 調廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Governor of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to governor of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 秋審，刑部進湖廣招冊，檢所定擬，多自緩決改情實，或改可矜。

translations.literal: At the autumn assize, the Ministry of Punishments submitted the Huguang case register; in the sentences Jian had fixed, many were changed from deferred execution to capital cases, or to cases deserving sympathy.
translations.idiomatic: At the autumn assize, the Ministry of Punishments submitted the Huguang case register; of the sentences Jian had fixed, many were changed from deferred execution to capital punishment, or to cases deserving leniency.

sentences.zh: 上覈刑部九卿所改皆允，諭檢「秋讞大典，宜詳慎持平，失出失入，厥過維均」，傳旨申飭。

translations.literal: The emperor reviewed the revisions by the Ministry of Punishments and the Nine Ministers and approved them all, instructing Jian: "The canon of the autumn assize requires careful and balanced judgment; leniency and severity alike are equal faults," and relayed an imperial admonition.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reviewed the Ministry of Punishments and the Nine Ministers' revisions and approved them all, then told Jian: "The canon of the autumn assize demands careful, even-handed judgment; excessive leniency and excessive severity are equally wrong," and sent an imperial rebuke.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，奏：「凡盜出洋肆劫，夥黨、器械，招買皆自內地。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he memorialized: "Whenever pirates go out to sea to plunder, their accomplices, weapons, and recruits are all supplied from the interior.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year he memorialized: "Whenever pirates put out to sea to rob, their accomplices, weapons, and recruits all come from the interior.

sentences.zh: 如果保甲嚴查，豈能藏匿？

translations.literal: If the baojia system were strictly enforced, how could they be hidden?
translations.idiomatic: If the baojia system were strictly enforced, how could they remain hidden?

sentences.zh: 請嗣後洋盜案發，詢明由某地出口，將專管及兼轄、統轄各員，照保甲不實力例議處。」

translations.literal: I request that hereafter, when a pirate case arises, once it is established from which place they departed, the officials directly in charge and those with concurrent or overall jurisdiction be punished according to the regulation for failure to enforce the baojia system."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that hereafter, when a pirate case occurs, once the port of departure is established, every official directly in charge or with concurrent or overall jurisdiction be punished under the regulation for lax enforcement of the baojia system."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 廣東有名竹洲艇者，其制上寬下銳，行駛極速。

translations.literal: In Guangdong there were boats called zhuzhou craft, built wide above and sharp below, and extremely swift.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangdong there were boats known as bamboo-islet craft, built wide at the top and sharp at the bottom, and extremely fast.

sentences.zh: 海盜用以行劫，追捕為難。

translations.literal: Pirates used them for robbery, making pursuit difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Pirates used them for raids, making pursuit difficult.

sentences.zh: 檢令凡船皆改平底。

translations.literal: Jian ordered that all boats be changed to flat bottoms.
translations.idiomatic: Jian ordered that all such boats be rebuilt with flat bottoms.

sentences.zh: 瓊州地懸海外，黎人那隆等劫商骫法，為諸盜最。

translations.literal: Qiongzhou lies beyond the sea; the Li tribesman Na Long and others robbed merchants and evaded the law, the worst among all pirates.
translations.idiomatic: Qiongzhou stands beyond the sea, and the Li chieftain Na Long and his followers robbed merchants and flouted the law, making them the worst of the pirates.

sentences.zh: 檢親督剿捕，決遣如律。

translations.literal: Jian personally supervised the campaign to capture them, and they were sentenced and dispatched according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Jian personally directed the campaign against them, and the culprits were sentenced and executed according to law.

sentences.zh: 又以民多聚族而居，置祭田名曰「嘗租」，租穀饒裕，每用以糾眾械鬥。

translations.literal: He also noted that the people often lived in clan settlements and set aside sacrificial fields called "changzu"; the grain rents were abundant and were often used to gather crowds for armed feuds.
translations.idiomatic: He also found that many people lived in clan settlements and maintained sacrificial fields called changzu; the rents were ample and were often used to muster armed clans for feuds.

sentences.zh: 奏請「嘗租自百畝以上者，留供每年祭祀，餘田歸本人。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting that "for changzu of a hundred mu or more, enough be kept for the annual sacrifices and the remaining land returned to the owners.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized asking that "for changzu of a hundred mu or more, only enough land to support the annual sacrifices be retained and the rest returned to the owners.

sentences.zh: 其以租利所置，按支均派，俾貧民有田以資生，兇徒無財以滋事」。

translations.literal: Land acquired from rental profits should be divided equally among the branches, so that the poor have fields to live on and violent men have no funds to stir up trouble."
translations.idiomatic: Land bought with rental profits should be divided equally among the branches, so that poor clansmen have fields to live on and violent men have no money to stir up trouble."

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「所奏意在懲兇息訟，惟恐有司奉行不善，族戶賢否不齊，難免侵漁攘奪。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "The purpose of this memorial is to punish the violent and quiet litigation, but I fear that if officials carry it out poorly, and clans vary in virtue and vice, encroachment and seizure will be hard to avoid.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "Your proposal aims to punish the violent and reduce litigation, but I fear that if officials carry it out poorly, and clans are uneven in character, encroachment and seizure will be hard to prevent.

sentences.zh: 嗣後因恃祠產豐厚，糾眾械鬥，按律懲治。

translations.literal: Hereafter, those who rely on abundant shrine property to gather crowds for armed feuds shall be punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, anyone who relies on rich shrine property to muster armed clans for feuds shall be punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 即以祠田如檢所請分給族人，俾兇徒知所警懼，而守分善良仍得保其世業。」

translations.literal: The shrine lands shall then be divided among the clansmen as Jian requested, so that violent men know fear, while the law-abiding and virtuous may still preserve their hereditary holdings."
translations.idiomatic: The shrine lands shall then be divided among the clansmen as Jian proposed, so that violent men are warned, while the law-abiding may still keep their hereditary holdings."

sentences.zh: 三十二年，因病請假，有詔慰問。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he requested leave on grounds of illness, and an edict was issued to inquire after his health.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year he asked for sick leave, and the emperor sent an edict of inquiry.

sentences.zh: 旋卒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after.

sentences.zh: 子啟緒，自編修官河南開歸陳許道；

translations.literal: His son Qixu, from compiler, served as intendant of the Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu Circuit in Henan;
translations.idiomatic: His son Qixu rose from compiler to intendant of the Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu Circuit in Henan;

sentences.zh: 燕緒，自編修官侍講；

translations.literal: Yanxu, from compiler, served as lecturer;
translations.idiomatic: Yanxu rose from compiler to lecturer in the Hanlin Academy;

sentences.zh: 孫慶長，內閣中書，官福建按察使。

translations.literal: His grandson Qingchang, a secretary in the Grand Secretariat, served as Judicial Commissioner of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Qingchang, a secretary in the Grand Secretariat, became judicial commissioner of Fujian.

sentences.zh: =吳士功=吳士功，字惟亮，河南光州人。

translations.literal: Wu Shigong: Wu Shigong, courtesy name Weiliang, a native of Guangzhou in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shigong, a native of Guangzhou in Henan, bore the courtesy name Weiliang.

sentences.zh: 雍正十一年進士，選庶吉士，改吏部主事。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the eleventh year of Yongzheng, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was transferred to be a principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of the eleventh year of Yongzheng, he was selected as a Hanlin bachelor and then transferred to the Ministry of Personnel as a principal clerk.

sentences.zh: 累遷郎中，考選御史。

translations.literal: He was successively promoted to department director and was selected by examination as a censor.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to department director and was selected by examination as a censor.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「部院大臣簡用督撫，調所屬司員以道府題補，恐滋偏聽、交結諸弊，請照雍正舊例停止。」

translations.literal: He memorialized: "When ministers and commissioners appoint governors and governors-general, they transfer their own subordinates and nominate them for circuit and prefectural posts, which may breed favoritism, collusion, and other abuses. I request that this be stopped according to the old Yongzheng precedent."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "When high ministers appoint governors and governors-general, they often transfer their own subordinates and nominate them for circuit and prefectural posts, which invites favoritism and collusion. I ask that this practice be stopped, following the Yongzheng precedent."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 御史仲永檀言密奏留中，近多洩漏。

translations.literal: Censor Zhong Yongtan said that confidential memorials kept at court had lately leaked frequently.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhong Yongtan reported that confidential memorials kept at court had been leaking frequently of late.

sentences.zh: 敕王大臣詰問，舉士功劾尚書史貽直疏以對。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered princes and ministers to interrogate him; he cited Shigong's memorial impeaching Minister Shi Yizhi in reply.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered princes and ministers to question him; he answered by citing Shigong's memorial impeaching Minister Shi Yizhi.

sentences.zh: 上出士功疏，戒以不悛改，當重譴。

translations.literal: The emperor produced Shigong's memorial and warned that if he did not reform, he would be severely punished.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor produced Shigong's memorial and warned that if he did not mend his ways, he would face severe punishment.

sentences.zh: 乾隆七年，授山東濟東泰武道，丁憂，服闋，調直隸大名道。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Qianlong he was appointed to the Ji-Dong-Tai-Wu Circuit in Shandong; he mourned a parent, and when mourning ended was transferred to the Daming Circuit in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Qianlong he was appointed intendant of the Ji-Dong-Tai-Wu Circuit in Shandong; after mourning a parent and completing the mourning period, he was transferred to the Daming Circuit in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 改山東兗沂曹道，屬縣飢，上南巡，迎駕，召對，以聞。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Yan-Yi-Cao Circuit in Shandong; the counties under his jurisdiction suffered famine. When the emperor toured south, Shigong met the imperial procession, was summoned for audience, and reported the situation.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to the Yan-Yi-Cao Circuit in Shandong, he found his counties suffering famine. When the emperor toured the south, Shigong met the imperial procession, was summoned for audience, and reported the situation.

sentences.zh: 為截留糧米六十萬石賑之，命士功董其事。

translations.literal: Six hundred thousand shi of grain were retained for relief, and Shigong was ordered to supervise the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Six hundred thousand shi of grain were set aside for relief, and Shigong was ordered to oversee the distribution.

sentences.zh: 旱蝗為災，督吏捕治，晝夜巡閱，未及旬，蝗盡。

translations.literal: Drought and locusts brought disaster; he supervised officials in capturing and exterminating them, inspecting day and night, and in less than ten days the locusts were gone.
translations.idiomatic: When drought and locusts struck, he supervised officials in exterminating them, inspecting day and night; in less than ten days the locusts were gone.

sentences.zh: 調湖南糧道，巡撫阿克敦疏留，調山東糧道。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the grain circuit of Hunan; Governor Akedun memorialized to retain him, and he was transferred to the grain circuit of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the grain circuit of Hunan, but Governor Akedun memorialized to keep him; he was then transferred to the grain circuit of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 再遷湖北按察使。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Judicial Commissioner of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred, becoming judicial commissioner of Hubei.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，護巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he served as acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 河南飢，敕湖北發毗連州縣倉米運河南，即留本年應運漕糧歸倉。

translations.literal: Henan suffered famine; an edict ordered Hubei to release grain from granaries in adjoining districts and counties for transport to Henan, and to retain that year's allotted tribute grain in the granaries.
translations.idiomatic: When Henan suffered famine, an edict ordered Hubei to release grain from granaries in adjoining districts and counties for shipment to Henan, and to keep that year's allotted tribute grain in store.

sentences.zh: 士功奏湖北地卑濕，米難久貯，請以一米改收二穀還倉，報聞。

translations.literal: Shigong memorialized that Hubei's land was low and damp and rice could not be stored long; he requested that for each shi of rice, two shi of grain be collected in return to the granaries. The report was acknowledged.
translations.idiomatic: Shigong memorialized that Hubei's low, damp terrain made rice hard to store for long, and asked that for each shi of rice released, two shi of grain be collected back into the granaries. The court took note.

sentences.zh: 遷陝西布政使，護巡撫。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Financial Commissioner of Shaanxi and served as acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to financial commissioner of Shaanxi and served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「宜君、榆林、葭州、懷遠、府谷、神木、靖邊、寧遠諸州縣先旱後潦。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The districts and counties of Yijun, Yulin, Jiazhou, Huaiyuan, Fugu, Shenmu, Jingbian, and Ningyuan suffered drought first and then flooding.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The districts and counties of Yijun, Yulin, Jiazhou, Huaiyuan, Fugu, Shenmu, Jingbian, and Ningyuan were stricken first by drought and then by flood.

sentences.zh: 撥寧夏米麥五萬石分賑懷遠、靖邊諸縣，中阻黃河，河冰即難挽運，臣飭先期速運；

translations.literal: Fifty thousand shi of rice and wheat from Ningxia were allocated for relief to Huaiyuan, Jingbian, and other counties; the Yellow River lies between, and once the river freezes transport becomes difficult, so I have ordered early rapid shipment;
translations.idiomatic: I have allocated fifty thousand shi of rice and wheat from Ningxia for relief to Huaiyuan, Jingbian, and other counties; the Yellow River lies between, and once it freezes transport becomes difficult, so I have ordered shipment to begin at once;

sentences.zh: 撥綏德等四州縣米二萬石協濟榆林、葭州，山路崎嶇，臣飭添僱騾駝速運，俾民早霑實惠。」

translations.literal: Twenty thousand shi of rice from Suide and four other districts and counties were allocated to assist Yulin and Jiazhou; the mountain roads are rugged, so I have ordered additional mules and camels hired for rapid transport, so the people may quickly receive real benefit."
translations.idiomatic: I have allocated twenty thousand shi of rice from Suide and four other districts and counties to assist Yulin and Jiazhou; the mountain roads are rugged, so I have ordered extra mules and camels hired for rapid transport, so the people may receive relief without delay."

sentences.zh: 諭令竭力妥為之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that it be carried out thoroughly and properly.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered that every effort be made to carry it out properly.

sentences.zh: 調直隸，奏請：「撫籓離任，將庫項有無虧空奏明。

translations.literal: Transferred to Zhili, he memorialized requesting: "When the governor and provincial treasurer leave office, they should report clearly whether the treasury accounts show any deficit.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Zhili, he memorialized asking that "when the governor and provincial treasurer leave office, they report clearly whether the treasury shows any deficit.

sentences.zh: 新任撫籓亦於交代限內另摺奏聞，仍照例出結保題，以除挪借積弊。」

translations.literal: The newly appointed governor and provincial treasurer should also submit a separate memorial within the handover deadline, and still furnish the usual bond and recommendation as before, to eliminate the longstanding abuse of unauthorized borrowing."
translations.idiomatic: The newly appointed governor and provincial treasurer should also submit a separate memorial within the handover period and still furnish the usual bond and recommendation, so as to eliminate the longstanding abuse of unauthorized borrowing."

sentences.zh: 上以所奏簡而易行，命著為例。

translations.literal: The emperor found the proposal simple and easy to implement and ordered it established as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor found the proposal simple and practical and ordered it made permanent regulation.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，復調陝西，護巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was again transferred to Shaanxi and served as acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was transferred back to Shaanxi and again served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「延安府兵米，各縣運府倉。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "For military grain in Yan'an prefecture, each county transports it to the prefectural granary.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "In Yan'an prefecture, each county transports military grain to the prefectural granary.

sentences.zh: 弁兵赴府支領，路遠費倍，耗損過半。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers go to the prefecture to draw rations; the roads are long, costs double, and more than half is lost in transport.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers must travel to the prefectural seat to draw rations; the distances are great, costs double, and more than half is lost in transport.

sentences.zh: 請甘泉、宜川、延川、延長四縣本縣徵收支給。」

translations.literal: I request that in the four counties of Ganquan, Yichuan, Yanchuan, and Yanchang, collection and disbursement be handled within each county."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that in Ganquan, Yichuan, Yanchuan, and Yanchang, grain be collected and issued within each county."

sentences.zh: 又奏：「隴州汧陽縣跬步皆山，歲徵屯豆，請改折色解司充餉。」

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "In Qianyang County, Longzhou, every step is mountain; the annual levy of garrison beans— I request conversion to a monetary payment submitted to the provincial treasury for rations."
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Qianyang County in Longzhou is mountainous throughout; for the annual levy of garrison beans, I ask that it be converted to a monetary payment submitted to the provincial treasury for rations."

sentences.zh: 俱從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 擢福建巡撫。

translations.literal: He was promoted to governor of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to governor of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，奏請捕私鑄，按錢數多寡治罪。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, he memorialized requesting the arrest of private coin casters and sentencing according to the quantity of cash minted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he memorialized asking that private coiners be arrested and punished according to the amount of cash they had minted.

sentences.zh: 又奏獲南洲盜八十餘人，與總督楊廷璋疏請改定南洲塘汛。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that more than eighty pirates at Nanzhou had been captured and, with Governor-General Yang Tingzhang, submitted a memorial requesting revision of the Nanzhou coastal defense posts.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported the capture of more than eighty Nanzhou pirates and, together with Governor-General Yang Tingzhang, memorialized for a reorganized coastal defense at Nanzhou.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「福建九府二州，常平缺額穀三十一萬石有奇；

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "In Fujian's nine prefectures and two departments, the Ever-Normal granaries are short more than 310,000 shi of grain;
translations.idiomatic: He also reported: "Fujian's nine prefectures and two departments are short more than 310,000 shi in the Ever-Normal granaries;

sentences.zh: 台灣積年平糶未買穀十五萬石有奇：皆令補足。

translations.literal: in Taiwan, grain sold at fair price over many years that was never replenished exceeds 150,000 shi: all are to be made up.
translations.idiomatic: on Taiwan, grain sold from the granaries at fair price over many years and never bought back comes to more than 150,000 shi—all of it is to be replenished.

sentences.zh: 浙西歉收，請撥台灣穀十萬石聽浙商販運。

translations.literal: Western Zhejiang had a poor harvest; he requested that 100,000 shi of Taiwan grain be allocated and Zhejiang merchants permitted to transport and sell it.
translations.idiomatic: With western Zhejiang suffering poor harvests, he asked that 100,000 shi of Taiwan grain be allocated for Zhejiang merchants to transport and sell.

sentences.zh: 風汛不便，先發內地沿海府縣倉穀撥給，俟台灣穀運到還倉。

translations.literal: Seasonal winds and tides made prompt shipment inconvenient; he asked first to release grain from coastal prefecture and county granaries on the mainland for distribution, and when Taiwan grain arrived, to return the granaries.
translations.idiomatic: Because seasonal winds and tides made transport inconvenient, he proposed first drawing on coastal granaries on the mainland, then replenishing them when the Taiwan grain arrived.

sentences.zh: 一轉移間，無妨於閩，有益於浙。」

translations.literal: With one transfer, Fujian would suffer no harm and Zhejiang would benefit."
translations.idiomatic: In a single transfer of stores, Fujian would lose nothing and Zhejiang would gain.

sentences.zh: 上嘉之。

translations.literal: The emperor commended this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended the proposal.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，奏：「寄居台灣皆閩、粵濱海之民，乾隆十二年復禁止移眷，民多冒險偷渡，內外人民皆朝廷赤子。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he memorialized: "Those living in Taiwan are all people from the coastal regions of Fujian and Guangdong. In the twelfth year of Qianlong, bringing families was again forbidden; the people often risked illegal crossings. Those within and without are all the emperor's children.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he reported: "Those who settle in Taiwan are coastal folk from Fujian and Guangdong. After the twelfth year of Qianlong brought back the ban on bringing families, people often risked illegal crossings—yet subjects on both shores of the strait are all the emperor's own people.

sentences.zh: 向之在台灣為匪者，均隻身無賴。

translations.literal: Those who had been bandits in Taiwan were all rootless ruffians acting alone.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had turned to banditry in Taiwan were all rootless ruffians acting alone.

sentences.zh: 若既報墾立業，必顧惜身家，各思保聚。

translations.literal: If they report reclamation and establish livelihoods, they will surely cherish their persons and property and each think of preserving and gathering their families.
translations.idiomatic: Once they register reclaimed land and settle into lawful livelihoods, they will cherish their lives and property and seek to keep their families together.

sentences.zh: 有的屬在內地者，請許報官給照，遷徙完聚。」

translations.literal: Some have relatives still on the mainland; he requested permission to report to officials, receive licenses, migrate, and reunite their families."
translations.idiomatic: For those with kin still on the mainland, he asked that they be allowed to report to officials, receive permits, and migrate to reunite their households."

sentences.zh: 又條奏稽查濱海漁船，令取船主、澳甲保結；

translations.literal: He also submitted detailed memorials on inspecting coastal fishing boats, requiring guarantor bonds from boat owners and harbor headmen;
translations.idiomatic: He also submitted detailed regulations for inspecting coastal fishing boats, requiring guarantor bonds from boat owners and harbor headmen;

sentences.zh: 出口逾期不還，責成澳甲、船主查報；

translations.literal: if they left port and overdue did not return, the harbor headmen and boat owners were held responsible to investigate and report;
translations.idiomatic: if a boat cleared port and failed to return on time, the harbor headman and owner would be held responsible to investigate and report;

sentences.zh: 稽察攜帶多貨，帆檣編字號，書姓名，免匪舟溷跡：均從之。

translations.literal: inspection of excessive cargo was enforced, sails marked with registration numbers and names written on them, to prevent pirate vessels mixing in: all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: cargo loads would be inspected, sails marked with registration numbers and owners' names written on them, so pirate craft could not blend in—all were approved.

sentences.zh: 尋以福建民多械鬥，由大族欺凌小族，疏請大戶恃強糾眾擬情實，小戶被欺抵禦擬緩決。

translations.literal: Soon, because Fujian people often fought with weapons and great clans bullied small ones, he memorialized requesting that powerful households who relied on strength to gather crowds be sentenced to death as the facts warranted, while small households bullied into resisting be sentenced to deferred execution.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, noting how common armed brawls were in Fujian and that large clans often oppressed smaller ones, he proposed that powerful lineages found guilty of mustering crowds by force be sentenced to death, while smaller households bullied into fighting back be given deferred sentences.

sentences.zh: 刑部擬駁，上諭曰：「福建械鬥最為惡俗。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Justice proposed rejection. The emperor instructed: "Armed brawling in Fujian is the most evil custom.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Justice recommended rejection. The emperor instructed: "Armed brawls in Fujian are among the worst local customs.

sentences.zh: 士功乃欲以族大族小分立科條，是使械鬥者得以趨避其詞，司讞者因而高下其手。

translations.literal: Shigong actually wished to establish separate statutes according to whether a clan was large or small—this would allow brawlers to shift their defense, and those administering justice to raise or lower their hand accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Shigong would divide the law between large and small clans, giving brawlers room to evade conviction and letting judges manipulate verdicts at will.

sentences.zh: 士功夙習沽名，宜刻自提撕，勿自貽伊戚！」

translations.literal: Shigong has long been accustomed to seeking reputation; he should strictly pull himself up and not bring calamity on himself!"
translations.idiomatic: Shigong has long courted a reputation for benevolence; he should pull himself up sharply and not bring trouble on himself!"

sentences.zh: 二十六年，廷璋劾提督馬龍圖挪用存營公項，命士功嚴讞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Tingzhang impeached Regional Commander Ma Longtu for embezzling camp funds held in storage and ordered Shigong to judge the case strictly.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year Yang Tingzhang impeached Regional Commander Ma Longtu for misappropriating stored camp funds, and Shigong was ordered to try the case rigorously.

sentences.zh: 會奏龍圖借用公項，已於盤查時歸補，援自首例減等擬徒。

translations.literal: Jointly they memorialized that Longtu had borrowed public funds and already restored them during an audit, invoking the precedent for voluntary confession to reduce the sentence by one degree and propose exile.
translations.idiomatic: In a joint memorial they reported that Longtu had borrowed public funds but restored them during an audit, and on the self-confession precedent proposed reducing his sentence by one degree to exile.

sentences.zh: 上以龍圖敗露後始行歸補，且將登記數簿焚毀，又增舞文之罪，不得以自首論，因究詰出何人意，尋覆奏士功主政。

translations.literal: The emperor said Longtu restored the funds only after exposure, and also burned the registration ledger, adding the offense of manipulating documents; self-confession could not apply. He then investigated whose idea this was, and soon a reply memorialized that Shigong had led the proceedings.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ruled that Longtu had restored the funds only after exposure and had burned the ledger of accounts—adding a charge of falsifying records—so self-confession did not apply. He demanded to know whose idea this had been, and a reply soon named Shigong as the one who had controlled the case.

sentences.zh: 上奪士功官，發巴里坤效力自贖。

translations.literal: The emperor stripped Shigong of office and sent him to Barkul to labor in redemption.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor stripped Shigong of rank and sent him to Barkul to labor in redemption of his offense.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，廷璋奏閩縣民楊魁等假造敕書承襲世職，投撫標效力。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, Tingzhang memorialized that Min County commoners Yang Kui and others forged imperial edicts to inherit hereditary offices and joined the garrison for service.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Yang Tingzhang reported that Yang Kui and others of Min County had forged imperial patents to claim hereditary posts and joined the provincial garrison.

sentences.zh: 上命巴里坤辦事大臣詰責士功，並令自揣應得處分，贖罪自效。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the Barkul commissioner to rebuke Shigong and also directed him to consider the punishment he deserved and redeem his guilt through service.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Barkul commissioner to rebuke Shigong and told him to propose what punishment he deserved and redeem his guilt through service.

sentences.zh: 士功輸銀贖罪，命釋回。

translations.literal: Shigong paid silver to redeem his guilt and was ordered released and sent back.
translations.idiomatic: Shigong paid a fine to redeem his offense and was ordered released.

sentences.zh: 旋卒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after.

sentences.zh: 子玉綸，二十六年進士，自檢討累遷兵部侍郎，督福建學政，复降授檢討。

translations.literal: His son Yulun, a jinshi of the twenty-sixth year, rose from compiler to vice minister of the Board of War, supervised Fujian education, then was again demoted to compiler.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yulun, who passed the jinshi examination in the twenty-sixth year, rose from compiler to vice minister of War and served as Fujian education commissioner before being demoted again to compiler.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：疆政首重宜民。

translations.literal: Commentary: The commentator says: In frontier governance, what matters most is making the people prosper.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: In frontier administration, the first priority is the welfare of the people.

sentences.zh: 紀督鑿井，反貽怨讟。

translations.literal: Governor Cui's well-digging instead brought complaints and censure.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Cui's well-digging projects, intended to help, only brought resentment and censure.

sentences.zh: 喀爾吉善遂阻開礦、種樹之議，興利誠不易言也。

translations.literal: Ka Erjishan then blocked proposals to open mines and plant trees—promoting profit is truly not easy to speak of.
translations.idiomatic: Ka Erjishan in turn blocked plans to open mines and plant trees; promoting the public welfare is easier said than done.

sentences.zh: 雅爾圖、應階治水，斯盛治社倉，哲治治賑，才有洪纖，效有鉅細，要皆有益於民。

translations.literal: Ya Ertu's and Yingjie's water control, Sisheng's community granaries, and Zhezhi's relief work—talents vary in scope, achievements in magnitude, but all benefited the people.
translations.idiomatic: Whether Ya Ertu and Yingjie regulating rivers, Sisheng managing community granaries, or Zhezhi organizing relief—talents differ in scale and achievements in size, but all served the people.

sentences.zh: 蘇昌劾大吏，頗見風力，瑚寶等亦各有建樹。

translations.literal: Su Chang impeached high officials, showing considerable force of character; Hu Bao and others each had their own achievements as well.
translations.idiomatic: Su Chang's impeachments of senior officials showed real moral courage, and Hu Bao and the others each had achievements of their own.

sentences.zh: 自古未有不盡心民事而可以稱善治者也。

translations.literal: From ancient times there has never been good governance that did not devote itself wholeheartedly to the people's affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Never, in any age, has sound governance been achieved without wholehearted devotion to the people's affairs.
